articles.title: Robert Griffin III announces plans to leave retirement and return to the NFL, with teams already showing interest
articles.standfirst: The 36-year-old insists he could operate in any offense despite not playing professionally since 2020
articles.summary: The 36-year-old insists he could operate in any offense despite not playing professionally since 2020
articles.body:
Six years away from the NFL have done little to diminish Robert Griffin III 's confidence in his ability to play quarterback, and the former Offensive Rookie of the Year believes a return could still become reality. Now working as a FOX Sports analyst, Griffin has spent years studying the league from a different perspective - and he believes that experience has helped him develop the knowledge he lacked during his playing career.

The 36-year-old revealed that he has discussed a potential comeback with NFL teams, although he stopped short of identifying the organizations involved, and offered an emphatic answer that suggested he has few concerns about adapting to the modern game. "Any of them," Griffin said to the Dan Patrick Show. "Yeah. I mean, right now, at this point in my life, with the amount of film I’ve had to watch, with the amount of growth I’ve made, you know, understanding the game, what the game needs, what you can’t do, what you have to do. Yeah, I can play in any system." His confidence comes from the extensive film study required for his broadcasting responsibilities, which he believes has sharpened his ability to recognize defenses and understand offensive concepts. However, he is not prepared to abandon a successful media career simply to generate attention or pursue an opportunity that does not make sense. "I’m not going to sacrifice that just to try to make headlines," Griffin added. "I can still throw a football and read a defense and have fun doing it, Dan. If they want me to go do it, they’ve got to, you know, I guess, pony up and make that happen." His comments follow repeated suggestions that he would consider returning, including a recent social media post claiming his daughters wanted to watch him play football again.

Griffin’s injuries transformed one of the NFL's brightest careers

Griffin entered professional football with enormous expectations after winning the 2011 Heisman Trophy at the Baylor Bears in the NCAA , before being selected second overall in the 2012 NFL Draft behind Andrew Luck . His spectacular rookie campaign with the Washington Redskins earned him Offensive Rookie of the Year honors, establishing him as one of the league's most exciting young quarterbacks. However, a serious knee injury during a playoff defeat against the Seattle Seahawks marked the beginning of a difficult period that significantly altered his career and effectively ended it. Further setbacks followed before the quarterback eventually joined the Cleveland Browns and later became a backup with the Baltimore Ravens , where he made his final NFL appearance in 2020. Griffin has previously questioned why struggling teams have overlooked experienced quarterbacks, arguing that veterans can provide stability when injuries disrupt a team's plans and has also showed an interest in representing the United States in flag football at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics . Although Griffin says conversations with NFL organizations have taken place, there has been no confirmation of a formal offer or an agreement with any team.

articles.title: Who will perform at the Eagles vs. Jaguars halftime show in London?
articles.standfirst: The NFL Week 5 matchup will feature live music. Here's what time the game starts and where to watch it.
articles.summary: The NFL Week 5 matchup will feature live music. Here's what time the game starts and where to watch it.
articles.body:
Tomorrow is NFL Sunday, and the Philadelphia Eagles and Jacksonville Jaguars are ready for their London showdown. Their matchup at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium will be one of the highlights of Week 5 , but this time, the attention won't be solely on the field. The game will also feature a musical performance bringing Afrobeats to the NFL's international stage.

How are the Eagles and Jaguars entering the London game?

The Jacksonville Jaguars have plenty of reasons to feel confident about their start to the season . With a 3-1 record and first place in the AFC South, the team is coming off a 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals and will look for another victory to maintain its position.

For Philadelphia, the outlook is different. The Eagles enter the matchup with a 2-2 record and two consecutive losses, a situation made more challenging by the injuries sidelining running back Saquon Barkley and wide receiver DeVonta Smith . Both are key pieces of the offense, meaning Philadelphia will have to take on the game without them.

Ayra Starr will headline the halftime show

Now, for the music: Nigerian singer Ayra Starr will take center stage, making history as the first African artist to headline a halftime show during the NFL's International Games series.

If you're not familiar with her music yet, start with Rush and Bloody Samaritan, two of her best-known songs. You can also check out Santa, her collaboration with Rvssian and Rauw Alejandro .

What time does Eagles vs. Jaguars start, and where can you watch it?

Kickoff is scheduled for 9:30 a.m. ET. Here are the start times by U.S. time zone:

Central Time (CT): 8:30 a.m.

Mountain Time (MT): 7:30 a.m.

Pacific Time (PT): 6:30 a.m.

Eastern Time (ET): 9:30 a.m.

The game will air on NFL Network and stream on NFL+ .

articles.title: Robert Griffin III on Arch Manning: “He needs to return to college for another year”
articles.standfirst: The former NFL quarterback believes the Texas player still needs more experience before making the jump to the professional level.
articles.summary: The former NFL quarterback believes the Texas player still needs more experience before making the jump to the professional level.
articles.body:
The future of Arch Manning is already one of the biggest debates in college football. The Texas quarterback is one of the names coming up in the early conversations ahead of the 2027 Draft , but Robert Griffin III believes he is not yet ready to make the jump to the NFL.

The former Washington Commanders quarterback and 2011 Heisman Trophy winner was clear when speaking about Manning’s future. “Arch Manning should absolutely come back for another year of college football. He needs more starts and more experience before going to the NFL” , Griffin wrote on X after Texas’ loss to Oklahoma.

RG3 believes Manning still needs experience

Griffin had already defended that position a few days earlier, during an appearance on The Herd alongside Colin Cowherd. For the former player, there is a sign that lets you know when a quarterback is ready for the NFL: college football starts to seem easy to him.

“I think he should come back another year. When players are ready to go to the NFL, college football seems easy to them. For Arch, it still doesn’t seem easy,” Griffin explained. As a reference, he mentioned his own experience and Andrew Luck’s, two quarterbacks who left college after seasons in which they clearly dominated the game.

Griffin's criticism is not related to Manning's talent. On the contrary, he believes his abilities are evident. His argument is based on experience and the need to accumulate more repetitions before facing NFL defenses.

Manning arrived at Texas as one of the top recruits of his generation and spent his first seasons as Quinn Ewers' backup. In 2024, he made two starts before becoming the Longhorns' starting quarterback in 2025.

They also question his reading speed

GR3's opinion is not the only one that focuses on Manning's development. David Pollack also recently pointed out a specific aspect of his game: the speed at which he processes defenses.

“Arch Manning has exceptional talent” , Pollack explained on The Dan Patrick Show. However, he considered that his processing “is consistently a step slow” and pointed out that the quarterback still needs more repetitions to gain consistency.

Manning has shown during his time at Texas that he has the physical tools to play in the NFL, as well as the ability to create plays when the offensive structure breaks down. The question, for Griffin and other analysts, is whether he already has the consistency needed to face the next level.

Will Arch Manning stay at Texas?

"The decision is still in the quarterback's hands. Manning has another season of eligibility and could remain at Texas in 2027 before entering the Draft.

"The possibility gained even more momentum after the loss to Oklahoma. Manning threw three touchdown passes, but suffered two interceptions in the fourth quarter . One of them was returned 42 yards for a touchdown by Peyton Bowen, and the other came in the final seconds, a turnover that allowed Oklahoma to set up the game-winning field goal. The Sooners ultimately prevailed 27-24.

For Griffin, those kinds of situations reinforce his argument: Manning has the talent to make it to the NFL, but he still needs to prove that he can control the most demanding college football games from start to finish.

For now, the quarterback will have to decide whether he feels ready to take the next step or whether he prefers to stay one more year in Texas to continue developing.

articles.title: Jason Kelce gets a brutal rugby welcome in London, then fights back like a legend
articles.standfirst: The former NFL center received a crash course in rugby fundamentals from Joe Marler, the former England international
articles.summary: The former NFL center received a crash course in rugby fundamentals from Joe Marler, the former England international
articles.body:
Jason Kelce spent 13 NFL seasons battling defensive linemen. In London, the former Philadelphia Eagles center discovered that rugby comes with its own learning curve. Kelce, 38, made a surprise grassroots rugby union debut with Old Streetonians , playing approximately 30 minutes in a training match against local rivals Hackney RFC at Hackney Marshes . The retired Super Bowl champion was in the United Kingdom to cover the Eagles' matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars for ESPN , but found time to try a sport that shares American football's physical demands while requiring a different set of skills.

His introduction was memorable. Kelce was knocked flat by a hand-off early in the session, then bounced back later to power through a tackle. The appearance, part of the content he was filming for his YouTube channel, gave the former NFL star a chance to experience rugby from the inside.

Joe Marler and Ilona Maher prepare Kelce for rugby

Kelce did not step onto the pitch without preparation. Before joining Old Streetonians , he received a crash course in rugby fundamentals from Joe Marler, the former England international and Harlequins prop. He also sought advice from Ilona Maher, one of the most recognizable figures in American rugby. The guidance was important.

Although rugby and American football share tackling, blocking and an oval ball, their rules and techniques differ considerably. Rugby players wear less protective equipment, must adapt to continuous play and cannot rely on the same pauses between downs that structure an NFL game . Kelce's experience as a center gave him a useful foundation, but rugby required him to adjust to unfamiliar movements, positioning and decision-making.

A rugby welcome at Hackney Marshes

Playing in a role resembling a number eight, Kelce took on the responsibilities of a forward expected to carry the ball and contribute to the physical contest around possession. The early hand-off sent him to the ground, providing a quick lesson in rugby's tackling techniques. He recovered and later drove through a tackle, showing flashes of the strength that made him an accomplished NFL offensive lineman.

Kelce was joined by Beau Allen , his former Eagles teammate and fellow Super Bowl champion. Their presence added an NFL connection to the local matchup, but the session was ultimately an opportunity to learn rather than compete at an elite level.

For Old Streetonians and Hackney RFC, the training match brought an unexpected visitor to a local rivalry. For Kelce , it was a chance to experience a new sport without the pressure of having to master it immediately.

Kelce's London trip extends beyond the NFL

Kelce's rugby appearance came during a visit centered on t he NFL's international schedule. The Eagles' game against the Jaguars was part of the league's London Games, which have helped expand American football's presence in the United Kingdom.

Since retiring, Kelce has moved into broadcasting with ESPN while continuing to connect with fans through his podcast and digital content. The rugby session offered a different kind of access, taking him away from the analyst's desk and into an unfamiliar sporting environment.

It also highlighted the connections between the two games. American football and rugby have distinct rules and traditions, but both rely on teamwork, tactical awareness and players willing to put themselves into demanding situations for their teammates. Kelce spent his entire 13-season NFL career with Philadelphia, becoming one of the league's premier centers and helping the Eagles win Super Bowl LII . Since retiring, he has remained a prominent voice in football.

His rugby debut was never about launching a second professional career. Instead, it gave him a chance to learn from experienced players, take on a new challenge and share the experience with his audience.

articles.title: Terry Bradshaw's anxiety over the possibility of losing his job on NFL Sunday: “It's my life”
articles.standfirst: The veteran pundit was facing pressure from fans to leave his post with FOX Sports
articles.summary: The veteran pundit was facing pressure from fans to leave his post with FOX Sports
articles.body:
Terry Bradshaw has secured his future on FOX Sports for two more years, but the NFL analyst has admitted that the possibility of losing his job has made him nervous for the first time in his broadcasting career. The 78-year-old, who won four Super Bowls with the Pittsburgh Steelers , signed a multi-year contract extension that will keep him on the network through its next Super Bowl broadcast.

The former quarterback also acknowledged the challenges of remaining relevant in a business increasingly shaped by younger personalities but made it clear that he has no intention of stepping away voluntarily. “I love my job,” Bradshaw told the Los Angeles Times. “This year was the first year that I got nervous. I wanted to extend my contract. So, I signed through the Super Bowl. Two more years. I’ll be 80. “Everybody in any business has to go. The young guys are coming. But I want to be relevant. I want to be good. I want to continue on. I want America to [tune in] and watch me. I want them to [like] me.”

Bradshaw's fear of life without FOX Sports' NFL Sunday

Bradshaw 's commitment comes despite criticism of his on-air performances in recent seasons as he has faced scrutiny over mispronounced player names, confusion surrounding team changes and getting sidetracked. During FOX 's coverage in the 2026 NFL season, Bradshaw also called for the New England Patriots to drop Drake Maye over brief poor form, despite him having had led his team to the Super Bowl just months earlier. Nevertheless, Bradshaw remains determined to continue working for as long as the network wants him. His current extension takes him through the 2028-29 season, when FOX is scheduled to broadcast the Super Bowl . And the Hall of Famer had described previously described how the prospect of being unable to work on Sundays as his biggest fear, underlining just how central broadcasting has become to his life. “I think my biggest fear, if I have a fear, is not being able to work at FOX NFL Sunday. It is my life,” Bradshaw said. “It's all I've ever done. It's what I listen, you get up and go to work; are you happiest? You can't wait to get to work. Are you that thrilled? articles.title: Jason Kelce's absence from the ESPN Monday Night Football booth was explained as Pat McAfee voiced one complaint
articles.standfirst: The Eagles' game in London conflicted with Kelce's Monday Night Football duties on ESPN
articles.summary: The Eagles' game in London conflicted with Kelce's Monday Night Football duties on ESPN
articles.body:
It may feel like it has been longer, but only since 2022 has ESPN featured two distinct broadcasts for Monday Night Football.

The main product offers the traditional pairing of Joe Buck and Troy Aikman , while the alternate ManningCast starring Peyton and Eli Manning brings a relaxed atmosphere filled with special guests, live banter, and expert breakdowns from two former Super Bowl champions , though that alternate broadcast does not run every week of the season.

Prior to kickoff, ESPN sets the stage with the Monday Night Countdown crew hosted by Scott Van Pelt, which since 2024 has featured retired stars Pat McAfee and Jason Kelce .

Beyond their deep football knowledge, McAfee and Kelce inject an unpredictable, humor-driven personality into the pregame show that sets a distinct tone, winning over plenty of viewers while drawing mixed reactions from traditionalists.

Jason Kelce’s Absence Explained

For this week's thriller between the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams , Kelce was conspicuously absent from the studio desk for a second consecutive week due to an international assignment in London.

The former Philadelphia Eagles All-Pro center spent the past 24 hours in the UK calling Philadelphia’s heart-wrenching 19-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium a dramatic defeat that Philly head coach Nick Sirianni personally took blame for after a costly late-game kickoff strategy backfired.

Kelce has now filled international booth duties in back-to-back games, building off his overseas debut during the Week 4 clash between the Washington Commanders and Indianapolis Colts .

However, his broadcast performances triggered social media friction after he repeatedly referred to the Eagles as "we" on air. NFL fans openly questioned his journalistic neutrality, noting he previously made a similar slip-up back in Week 3 during Philadelphia's 27-7 loss to Chicago.

While Kelce issued a public apology for his biased phrasing after McAfee playfully called him out on air , the habit persisted into Week 5, prompting broadcast executives to intervene.

While McAfee occasionally references his former Colts franchise, their gridiron accomplishments diverge, with Kelce having anchored a historic Super Bowl championship roster in Philadelphia.

Heading into Sunday's game, Jeff Dufine , a veteran ESPN producer managing the network's international broadcasts for the first time, revealed to The Philadelphia Inquirer that the production team was actively coaching Kelce to break the habit.

"We’ve tried to get the 'we' out of him," Dufine admitted, underscoring the delicate transition retired icons face when stepping off the gridiron and into the objective media booth.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce welcome back an old Chiefs ally: he has three Super Bowl rings
articles.standfirst: Justin Watson returns to Kansas City to bolster the receiving corps after Tyquan Thornton's injury, and his former teammates were quick to welcome him back.
articles.summary: Justin Watson returns to Kansas City to bolster the receiving corps after Tyquan Thornton's injury, and his former teammates were quick to welcome him back.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs turned to a familiar face to deal with one of the first major setbacks of the season. Justin Watson is back with the franchise after Andy Reid confirmed his addition to the practice squad, a move that prompted an immediate reaction from several of his former teammates, including Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce.

The return comes after Tyquan Thornton's injury , who suffered a dislocated ankle during the 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders. The receiver was placed on injured reserve, and Kansas City needed to add depth at a position that was already affected by other absences.

Mahomes and Kelce react to Justin Watson's return

Watson announced his return to Kansas City via Instagram with a photograph in which he appears dressed in the Chiefs' colors. His former teammates were quick to respond.

Mahomes reacted with three biceps emojis, while Kelce left an even more enthusiastic message: “😈😈 LFG!!!”. Other players such as Nikko Remigio, Drue Tranquill, and James Winchester also publicly celebrated the receiver's return.

Watson knows the locker room well and, above all, Andy Reid's offensive system. The receiver played in Kansas City between 2022 and 2024 , so his return means bringing back a player who already knows how the offense works and what it takes to play with Mahomes.

Watson already knows what it’s like to win with the Chiefs

Watson, 30, played in 50 regular-season games with Kansas City and started 20 of them. Over those three seasons, he recorded 64 receptions for 1,064 yards and seven touchdowns. He also added nine receptions for 120 yards in his three playoff appearances with the franchise.

His return also has a particular detail. Watson has three Super Bowl rings : one won with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and two with the Chiefs.

The first came in the 2020 season, when Tampa Bay defeated Kansas City itself in Super Bowl LV. Watson was part of that squad, although he was not on the active roster for the game. He then won the Super Bowls LVII and LVIII with the Chiefs.

Andy Reid bets on a player who already knows the system

Reid highlighted that familiarity precisely when explaining the decision to bring Watson back. The coach knows his traits and understands what he can contribute to Kansas City's offense.

The receiver stands out for his speed, size, and ability to create plays downfield. In his previous stint with the Chiefs, 49 of his 64 receptions resulted in gains of at least 10 yards, a figure that explains part of the team's interest in bringing him back.

Now he will have to earn his place on the team again. Watson was signed to the practice squad, not the active 53-man roster, although he can be elevated for certain games.

The Chiefs need depth after Thornton's injury

Thornton's injury left a significant gap in Kansas City's receiving corps. The player dislocated his left ankle in the victory over the Raiders and was placed on injured reserve, so he will miss at least several weeks.

Kansas City ultimately decided to go with a familiar face instead of waiting for a new receiver to learn Reid's system from scratch. Watson already knows the offense, has experience with Mahomes, and knows what it means to play in the big games.

His return, moreover, was welcomed enthusiastically by two of the main figures in the locker room. Mahomes and Kelce have already welcomed him back. Now Watson will have to prove on the field that he can still be useful for a Chiefs team that started the season with a 4-0 record.

articles.title: Chiefs vs. 49ers again? Super Bowl LXI rematch suddenly looks possible
articles.standfirst: Kansas City and San Francisco are playing the best football of the year
articles.summary: Kansas City and San Francisco are playing the best football of the year
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs and San Francisco 49ers are giving NFL fans an early reason to imagine another Super Bowl showdown . Through five weeks of the 2026 season, Kansas City is 4-0, while San Francisco has improved to 5-0 after a dramatic 32-29 victory over the Seattle Seahawks.

Both teams have legitimate championship credentials. The Chiefs have Patrick Mahomes and a proven postseason formula, while the 49ers have paired an undefeated start with a defense capable of changing games. A rematch of Super Bowl LVIII remains far from certain, but the early results make it a credible possibility.

Super Bowl LXI is scheduled for Feb. 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. To get there, Kansas City must win the AFC, and San Francisco must emerge from the NFC playoffs.

The Chiefs have started fast behind Mahomes

Kansas City has won its first four games, including a 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 4. The Chiefs' next scheduled opponent is the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 6. Mahomes remains the centerpiece of Kansas City's championship hopes. His ability to extend plays and deliver in critical moments gives the Chiefs a foundation few teams can match.

The offense has also shown it can win in different ways. Running back Kenneth Walker III, who joined Kansas City after spending the first four seasons of his NFL career with Seattle, rushed for 177 yards and two touchdowns against the Raiders. Wide receiver Tyquan Thornton caught five passes for 111 yards and two touchdowns in the same game.

That balance makes Kansas City difficult to defend. Still, the Chiefs must sustain their production against a demanding schedule and stay healthy as the season progresses. Mahomes and head coach Andy Reid give them a proven foundation, but another deep playoff run will have to be earned.

The 49ers keep finding ways to win

San Francisco improved to 5-0 with Sunday's 32-29 road victory over Seattle , surviving a difficult divisional matchup to remain undefeated. The 49ers' defense recorded four takeaways and five sacks, while the offense made the late plays necessary to secure the win . Rookie defensive lineman Gracen Halton recorded his first NFL sack a nd scored a defensive touchdown.

Quarterback Brock Purdy remains central to the team's ambitions. Kyle Shanahan's offensive system gives him opportunities to distribute the ball and exploit defensive matchups, while the defense has demonstrated it can influence games even when the offense struggles.

Injuries are a concern, particularly at wide receiver. Deebo Samuel suffered a hamstring injury against Seattle, and San Francisco will need enough healthy playmakers to maintain its production. The undefeated record is an impressive start, but the 49ers must keep winning in a competitive NFC West and navigate the conference's other contenders.

The Super Bowl LVIII connection

The prospect of another Chiefs-49ers meeting carries a compelling history. Kansas City defeated San Francisco 25-22 in overtime in Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024, with Mahomes leading the decisive drive to secure the championship. That result would give a potential rematch an obvious storyline: San Francisco could seek revenge, while Kansas City would have another opportunity to reinforce its standing among the NFL's defining teams of the Mahomes era.

But history alone cannot make the matchup happen. Both teams must maintain their form, manage injuries and survive the playoffs. Kansas City faces a competitive AFC field, while San Francisco must navigate the NFC's challenging postseason bracket.

Is Chiefs vs. 49ers a realistic Super Bowl LXI prediction? It is a credible early-season possibility, not yet a prediction. Kansas City's 4-0 start and San Francisco's 5-0 record put both teams in a strong position, but five weeks cannot establish who will reach February's championship game.

The Chiefs need to keep their offense balanced and convert their early success into sustained dominance. The 49ers must continue winning while managing injuries and proving they can handle the NFC's best teams.

articles.title: Alaric Jackson takes out his frustration and punches Bradley Chubb after the Rams’ dramatic loss to the Bills
articles.standfirst: The Rams tackle struck the Bills linebacker during postgame handshakes and jersey exchanges
articles.summary: The Rams tackle struck the Bills linebacker during postgame handshakes and jersey exchanges
articles.body:
T he tension from the Rams-Bills game spilled over after the final whistle. As players exchanged jerseys and spoke on the field, Los Angeles tackle Alaric Jackson approached Buffalo linebacker Bradley Chubb and punched him in the jaw. The hit knocked Chubb’s hat off and was captured on camera. The NFL also published video of the incident.

The altercation happened Monday, October 12, after Buffalo beat Los Angeles 37-34 in overtime. Jackson was exchanging jerseys with Bills lineman Deone Walker when he and Chubb exchanged words. Reports have not confirmed what either player said or what prompted Jackson to throw the punch.

Bradley Chubb says he chose not to retaliate

Players from both teams quickly separated the two. Rams tight end Colby Parkinson pulled Jackson away, while Chubb’s teammates intervened as well. During a postgame interview on the field, Bills quarterback Josh Allen looked toward the commotion and said they needed to break something up.

Chubb said he was fine and decided not to escalate the confrontation. “It’s just emotions, you know what I mean? Emotional game. It was a close game,” he told the California Post.

He added that he let Jackson swing, then was held back by his teammates. Chubb also said he was ready to play the following week.

The loss came after a tense overtime finish. The Rams missed a chance to win, and Buffalo secured the victory with a field goal by Tyler Bass. Chubb said tempers had flared during an emotional game, but that he and the Bills had moved on.

articles.title: Three NFC East coaches are in the hot seat after Week 5. Is a major shake-up coming?
articles.standfirst: The margin for error is shrinking, even though none of them are necessarily on the verge of being fired
articles.summary: The margin for error is shrinking, even though none of them are necessarily on the verge of being fired
articles.body:
T he NFC East could be heading toward an offseason coaching shake-up. Five weeks into the 2026 NFL season, Brian Schottenheimer, Nick Sirianni and Dan Quinn are facing mounting pressure as the Cowboys struggle for consistency, the Eagles spiral through a three-game losing streak and the Commanders waste opportunities to save their season.

If the results don't improve, all three could find their jobs under scrutiny, especially if John Harbaugh turns the Giants into a serious division contender in his first year in New York. The stakes are different for each coach.

Schottenheimer must prove he can turn Dak Prescott's production into sustained success. Sirianni has a Super Bowl title and a strong winning record to defend, but Philadelphia's recent collapse is raising questions about his game management. Quinn, meanwhile, needs Washington to find its footing as Jayden Daniels works his way back from another elbow injury.

None is necessarily on the verge of being fired. But with expectations high and the season already threatening to slip away for two of the three teams, the margin for error is shrinking.

Brian Schottenheimer: Dak Prescott's success raises the pressure

Schottenheimer's problem in Dallas is that the Cowboys have not been consistent enough, even with Prescott playing at a high level. Through 22 games under Schottenheimer, Dallas has managed only one streak of consecutive victories lasting at least two games: a three-game run that included wins over the Raiders, Eagles and Chiefs last season. That lack of sustained success is a troubling pattern for a franchise that expects to compete for championships.

Prescott's performance makes the criticism harder to dismiss. He has produced strong results under several previous head coaches, including Jason Garrett and Mike McCarthy, as well as under offensive coordinator Kellen Moore. If the quarterback continues to perform, Schottenheimer must show that he can turn that production into consistent team success.

The Cowboys' latest loss , a 24-16 defeat to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, intensified the scrutiny. Dallas struggled to convert third downs, failed to adapt effectively to Tampa Bay's pressure and committed costly turnovers. The result raised fresh questions about the game plan and Schottenheimer's in-game decisions.

The defensive situation is also complicating his position. Dallas is working with second-year defensive coordinator Christian Parker, who is in his first season in that role with the Cowboys. Through five games, the defense ranked 31st in total yards allowed and 25th in scoring defense, prompting owner Jerry Jones to bring in veteran assistant Mike Pettine to help the staff.

Nick Sirianni: A strong résumé meets a three-game skid

Sirianni's situation is more complicated because his record provides a compelling argument in his favor. He has a 61-28 regular-season record and a 6-4 postseason mark, including a Super Bowl championship . Those achievements are not easily dismissed after a difficult stretch, and Philadelphia has previously shown an ability to recover from slow starts and improve as the season progresses.

But the Eagles have lost three consecutive games and sit at 2-3 after their 19-17 defeat to Jacksonville in London . The latest loss was particularly painful because Philadelphia had an opportunity to protect its lead, only to allow a long kickoff return with eight seconds remaining. Jacksonville then made a 57-yard field goal to win.

Sirianni accepted responsibility for the decision to kick the ball deep rather than use a safer strategy to close out the game. It was the sort of late-game mistake that can magnify existing concerns about coaching decisions.

Philadelphia's injury problems provide important context. Key players, including running back Saquon Barkley and wide receiver DeVonta Smith, missed the Jacksonville game , while other absences have affected the team's depth. T he Eagles' struggles cannot be attributed to the head coach alone. Still, a championship résumé does not offer unlimited protection.

Dan Quinn: Washington's season depends heavily on Daniels

Quinn faces a different challenge in Washington. The Commanders' season has been shaped by the availability of Daniels , who missed two games after dislocating his left elbow in Week 2. Daniels returned against the Giants in Week 5 wearing a protective brace. His presence offered a boost, but Washington could not turn it into a victory. The Commanders and Giants finished in a 27-27 tie after Washington failed to complete a game-winning field-goal attempt in overtime. Quinn accepted responsibility for the clock-management problems that contributed to the missed opportunity.

The tie left Washington at 1-3-1, a difficult position for a team that entered the season with postseason ambitions. Quinn is now in his third year as head coach, and the team's inability to close out games has increased the scrutiny of his leadership.

Daniels' health is central to the Commanders' prospects , but it cannot explain every problem. Washington must improve its situational execution and make better use of the opportunities it creates. A quarterback returning from an elbow dislocation can provide a lift, but relying on him to rescue every game is not a sustainable strategy.

Quinn's challenge is to demonstrate that Washington can make progress even as it manages injuries and a difficult start. If the team continues to waste late-game opportunities, questions about his future will become harder to avoid.

Through 22 games under Schottenheimer, Dallas has managed only one streak of consecutive victories lasting at least two games: a three-game run that included wins over the Raiders, Eagles and Chiefs last season. That lack of sustained success is a troubling pattern for a franchise that expects to compete for championships.

Prescott's performance makes the criticism harder to dismiss. He has produced strong results under several previous head coaches, including Jason Garrett and Mike McCarthy, as well as under offensive coordinator Kellen Moore. If the quarterback continues to perform, Schottenheimer must show that he can turn that production into consistent team success.

The Cowboys' latest loss , a 24-16 defeat to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, intensified the scrutiny. Dallas struggled to convert third downs, failed to adapt effectively to Tampa Bay's pressure and committed costly turnovers. The result raised fresh questions about the game plan and Schottenheimer's in-game decisions.

The defensive situation is also complicating his position. Dallas is working with second-year defensive coordinator Christian Parker, who is in his first season in that role with the Cowboys. Through five games, the defense ranked 31st in total yards allowed and 25th in scoring defense, prompting owner Jerry Jones to bring in veteran assistant Mike Pettine to help the staff.
Nick Sirianni: A strong résumé meets a three-game skid

Sirianni's situation is more complicated because his record provides a compelling argument in his favor. He has a 61-28 regular-season record and a 6-4 postseason mark, including a Super Bowl championship . Those achievements are not easily dismissed after a difficult stretch, and Philadelphia has previously shown an ability to recover from slow starts and improve as the season progresses.

But the Eagles have lost three consecutive games and sit at 2-3 after their 19-17 defeat to Jacksonville in London . The latest loss was particularly painful because Philadelphia had an opportunity to protect its lead, only to allow a long kickoff return with eight seconds remaining. Jacksonville then made a 57-yard field goal to win.

Sirianni accepted responsibility for the decision to kick the ball deep rather than use a safer strategy to close out the game. It was the sort of late-game mistake that can magnify existing concerns about coaching decisions.

Philadelphia's injury problems provide important context. Key players, including running back Saquon Barkley and wide receiver DeVonta Smith, missed the Jacksonville game , while other absences have affected the team's depth. T he Eagles' struggles cannot be attributed to the head coach alone. Still, a championship résumé does not offer unlimited protection.
Dan Quinn: Washington's season depends heavily on Daniels

Quinn faces a different challenge in Washington. The Commanders' season has been shaped by the availability of Daniels , who missed two games after dislocating his left elbow in Week 2. Daniels returned against the Giants in Week 5 wearing a protective brace. His presence offered a boost, but Washington could not turn it into a victory. The Commanders and Giants finished in a 27-27 tie after Washington failed to complete a game-winning field-goal attempt in overtime. Quinn accepted responsibility for the clock-management problems that contributed to the missed opportunity.

The tie left Washington at 1-3-1, a difficult position for a team that entered the season with postseason ambitions. Quinn is now in his third year as head coach, and the team's inability to close out games has increased the scrutiny of his leadership.

Daniels' health is central to the Commanders' prospects , but it cannot explain every problem. Washington must improve its situational execution and make better use of the opportunities it creates. A quarterback returning from an elbow dislocation can provide a lift, but relying on him to rescue every game is not a sustainable strategy.

Quinn's challenge is to demonstrate that Washington can make progress even as it manages injuries and a difficult start. If the team continues to waste late-game opportunities, questions about his future will become harder to avoid.

articles.title: Donna Kelce’s T-shirt fundraiser turned Jason and Travis’ NFL fame into help for their hometown schools
articles.standfirst: Her “Rooting for the Offense” shirt supported the Cleveland Heights school community that helped raise her sons
articles.summary: Her “Rooting for the Offense” shirt supported the Cleveland Heights school community that helped raise her sons
articles.body:
W hen Jason Kelce’s Eagles and Travis Kelce’s Chiefs prepared to face each other in November 2023, their mother found a way to support both sons and give back to the community where they grew up. Donna Kelce teamed up with Jason, Travis and Ohio-based apparel company HOMAGE on a T-shirt fundraiser benefiting the Heights Schools Foundation in Cleveland Heights, Ohio.

The shirt’s message, “Rooting for the Offense,” captured Donna’s way of avoiding the question of which team she wanted to win: both sons play offense. The design showed a caricature of Donna in her signature glasses and bangs, sitting on a bleacher bench. One side of her shirt featured Eagles colors; the other, Chiefs colors.

Donna Kelce wanted to give back to the community that raised her sons

The cause was personal. Donna told The Philadelphia Inquirer that Cleveland Heights’ coaches, teachers, students and parents helped teach her sons life lessons and supported their family. “It is so very important for me to help support Cleveland Heights,” she said.

Jason graduated from Cleveland Heights High School in 2006, and Travis followed in 2008. The Heights Schools Foundation supports students and staff across the Cleveland Heights–University Heights school system with scholarships, teacher grants and educational programs. The foundation said more than 71% of students in the district received needs-based assistance.

Donna had worked with HOMAGE on the design in the weeks before it was revealed during an Eagles game in October 2023. HOMAGE’s founder surprised her with the finished shirt, which gave the brothers’ NFL spotlight a purpose beyond their matchup. Jason said his mother had found a way to turn the attention surrounding the game into support for the community.

The shirt sold for $36 at launch, with proceeds benefiting the foundation. The reports reviewed did not specify how much the fundraiser ultimately raised. What they did make clear was Donna’s reason for doing it: honoring the Cleveland Heights community that had helped shape her family.

articles.title: Tyreek Hill’s latest sprint raises concerns as NFL comeback talks heat up
articles.summary: Tyreek Hill is back sprinting, but his latest workout video has some NFL fans questioning whether his devastating knee injury is still affecting his movement.
articles.body:
Tyreek Hill is back sprinting, but his latest workout video has some NFL fans questioning whether his devastating knee injury is still affecting his movement.

Hill dislocated his left knee and tore multiple ligaments, including his ACL, in September 2025. The injury required two surgeries and ended his final season with Miami after only four games.

The free-agent receiver appears to show a slight hitch while accelerating, although a short video cannot determine his medical condition. With several teams reportedly interested, Hill’s ability to regain his explosive speed could determine where his comeback begins.

articles.title: Zach Loboy, coach of Marist Catholic High School, is fired after leading his team to a 63-0 halftime lead over Cottage Grove
articles.standfirst: Zach Loboy has lost his job as a coach at Marist Catholic High School
articles.summary: Zach Loboy has lost his job as a coach at Marist Catholic High School
articles.body:
Zach Loboy , head coach of the Marist Catholic high school football team, was fired after his decisive 63-0 victory against their longtime rival, Cottage Grove .

Our top priority is supporting our players, creating a positive team environment

The "High School" coach lost his job for, according to the Oregon institute (United States), unsportsmanlike conduct .

In an email addressed to parents, the school explained the coach's dismissal: "Our top priority is to support our players, create a positive team environment, and help the team finish the season successfully... It was determined that a change in leadership was necessary to reflect our school's mission and values. We are aware that a mid-season coaching change may be difficult for players and their families. We appreciate your understanding, support, and prayers during this transition period".

“It’s really stupid and unsportsmanlike. We’re talking about high school sports. At this level, winning is important, but so is building character and integrity, since these boys are being helped to become young men”

Those "values" included not attempting an "onside kick" when the score was 57-0 in our favor during the first half .

"It's really stupid and unsportsmanlike. We're talking about high school sports. At this level, winning is important, but so is building character and integrity, since you're helping these boys become young men. Letting the backup players score is one thing; but trying an onside kick is something else entirely! Should the coach be fired? I guess that depends on whether he had already received prior warnings or not," commented a parent.

The game was suspended when the halftime score was 63-0

The game was suspended when the score showed a resounding 63-0 at halftime.

Cottage Grove's athletic director explained in "The Register-Guard" that the game was ended because it was "what was best for the players, the fans, and everyone involved" .

Last season Cottage Grove finished with a 1-8 record, and in their last three games the "Lions" have been outscored by a combined 105-0.

articles.title: What NFL Teams have a Bye Week 6? Everyone who's out for this week
articles.standfirst: Four franchises will sit out Week 6 of the 2026 NFL season, giving players an opportunity to recover while fantasy football managers must find replacements for some of their biggest names
articles.summary: Four franchises will sit out Week 6 of the 2026 NFL season, giving players an opportunity to recover while fantasy football managers must find replacements for some of their biggest names
articles.body:
The NFL's 2026 regular season is moving into a crucial stretch, and Week 6 brings the first significant scheduling challenge for fans tracking all 32 teams.

While most franchises will be back on the field between Thursday, October 15, and Monday, October 19, four teams will not play at all this week.

The Cincinnati Bengals, Detroit Lions, Miami Dolphins and Minnesota Vikings are the four franchises scheduled for a bye.

Their players will have a weekend away from game action, while coaching staffs can use the break to review their performances and prepare for the remainder of the campaign. The schedule has been confirmed by both FOX Sports and the NFL's official listings.

For supporters, a bye week means waiting an extra week to see their team compete. For fantasy football players, however, it can require some immediate decisions.

Managers who rely on players from Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami or Minnesota will need to check their lineups and consider alternatives before their Week 6 matchups begin.

The four teams arrive at their break at different points in their respective seasons. Minnesota has made an impressive start, while Cincinnati, Detroit and Miami will have their own reasons to use the pause constructively.

The additional preparation time could prove valuable as teams work through injuries, assess tactical adjustments and prepare for the second half of the regular season.

Which four teams are missing Week 6, and what happens next?

Here is the complete list of NFL teams with a bye during Week 6:

None of these franchises will play a game between October 15 and October 19. Their next scheduled appearances will come in Week 7, when the regular-season schedule resumes for them.

The bye-week system is designed to give every NFL team one scheduled break during the 18-week regular season.

Each franchise plays 17 games, so the league builds in one week without a fixture for every team. The breaks are staggered to keep the majority of the league in action each weekend.

The timing can make a difference. A team that has struggled during the opening weeks can use the time to regroup, while a side that has built momentum may look to preserve its form and avoid losing rhythm.

Coaches can also evaluate film, make adjustments and give players extra time to recover from the physical demands of professional football.

Week 6 is not a particularly large bye round compared with some later points on the calendar, but four teams still represent a substantial portion of the player pool. Fantasy managers should pay particular attention to their starting quarterbacks, running backs, wide receivers and tight ends from these franchises.

A player can be in excellent form and still contribute nothing to a fantasy score during his team's scheduled rest week.

The break also affects the wider NFL viewing schedule. With four teams unavailable, the remaining 28 franchises will provide the action across the week, including the Seattle Seahawks ' Thursday night visit to the Denver Broncos and the Houston Texans ' international meeting with the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium in London on Sunday.

Other Week 6 matchups include the Chicago Bears against the Atlanta Falcons , the Baltimore Ravens against the Cleveland Browns , and the Los Angeles Chargers against the Kansas City Chiefs .

The Dallas Cowboys will visit the Green Bay Packers on Sunday night, before the Washington Commanders face the San Francisco 49ers on Monday night.

The bye schedule continues in Week 7, when the Buffalo Bills, Jacksonville Jaguars, Los Angeles Chargers and Washington Commanders are due to sit out. The following week, the Houston Texans, New Orleans Saints, New York Giants and San Francisco 49ers will receive their break.

For now, the key takeaway is straightforward: the Bengals, Lions, Dolphins and Vikings are the four teams missing from Week 6. Their absence may change fantasy lineups and viewing plans, but it also gives those franchises a valuable opportunity to recover and prepare for the challenges ahead.

articles.summary: San Francisco and Washington headline a day of undefeated leaders and desperate cellar-dwellers
articles.body:
The sixth week of the 2026/27 NFL season arrives with a clear script: at the top, a handful of teams that remain undefeated; at the bottom, several franchises still searching for their first win and whose margin for error is running out week by week.

Between Thursday Night in Jacksonville and the close of Monday Night in Santa Clara , there is something for everyone: heated divisional matchups, a blockbuster in the AFC West, and stern tests for the unbeaten teams.

San Francisco 49ers vs Washington Commanders

Where to watch: ESPN and ABC

San Francisco 49ers vs Washington Commanders, featured game of Week 6

Monday Night Football at Levi"s Stadium in Santa Clara pits two teams on opposite trajectories against each other. The San Francisco 49ers arrive as one of only two undefeated teams in the entire NFL: 5-0 , leaders of the NFC West and second in the overall standings with a +61 point differential (154 points scored, 93 allowed), the best offense in the conference. Across from them, the Washington Commanders (1-1-3) sit at the bottom of the NFC East and carry a fragile defense: 149 points allowed, the second-worst figure in the NFC.

San Francisco's offense has more than enough names to exploit that weakness. Quarterback Brock Purdy leads an offense loaded with weapons: running back Christian McCaffrey, tight end George Kittle and a receiving corps featuring Brandon Aiyuk, Deebo Samuel Sr., Mike Evans and Christian Kirk, all protected by veteran tackle Trent Williams. It's an arsenal that few defenses can contain.

Washington, for its part, is relying on the talent of its quarterback Jayden Daniels and top-tier receivers like Terry McLaurin and Stefon Diggs, with Austin Ekeler and Rachaad White in the backfield. The problem is not scoring —115 points in five games— but stopping opponents: if they do not make adjustments on defense, the unbeaten home team could turn the night into an offensive festival.

What are the NFL Week 6 predictions?

At Levi's Stadium, logic points to the 49ers: undefeated, at home, and with a superior offense against a defense that can't stop anyone. It's hard to see Washington containing Purdy and company for four quarters.

In the AFC West, Kansas City starts as the clear favorite in Los Angeles against a Chargers team still without a win, and Baltimore arrives with the momentum to prevail in Cleveland. San Francisco's unbeaten record, barring a massive upset, should remain intact by the end of the gameweek.

articles.title: Pat McAfee drops truth bomb on rumors he's replacing Troy Aikman
articles.standfirst: Pat McAfee shuts down shocking ESPN rumors after Troy Aikman’s potential exit sparks speculation about a Monday Night Football shakeup.
articles.summary: Pat McAfee shuts down shocking ESPN rumors after Troy Aikman’s potential exit sparks speculation about a Monday Night Football shakeup.
articles.body:
The future of the Monday Night Football booth continues to fuel rumors at ESPN , but one of the options that generated the most buzz has now been ruled out. Pat McAfee flatly denied that there is any plan for him to replace Troy Aikman if the former quarterback decides to leave the network in 2027 .

The controversy began after a report surfaced about alleged tension between Aikman and Joe Buck , his broadcast partner for the past several years. Aikman himself partially confirmed the report, leaving open the possibility of leaving ESPN when his contract expires at the end of the season.

The duo’s final scheduled broadcast is Super Bowl LXI in February 2027 , a scenario that has fueled speculation about who could take Aikman’s place on the NFL’s marquee broadcast.

Pat McAfee denies being Troy Aikman’s successor

As rumors grew on social media, several reports began pointing to Pat McAfee as one of ESPN’s possible options to join Joe Buck in the booth.

However, the host of The Pat McAfee Show publicly shot down the reports, saying there was never a conversation about bringing him to Monday Night Football .

I’ve already posted that this is not real. There are things involving Monday Night Football happening very publicly. We are big fans of Joe Buck and Troy Aikman. I’m not supposed to be in a football broadcast booth, and there has never been a conversation about me being in the Monday Night Football booth.

McAfee’s statement was emphatic and all but closed the door on him becoming an ESPN analyst in the short term.

ESPN Will Need Another Option if Aikman Leaves

Although McAfee has NFL broadcasting experience, having joined the booth for a Detroit Lions vs. Green Bay Packers game in 2018 , everything points to him not being the choice to fill Aikman’s seat.

For now, ESPN will have to explore other alternatives if the former Dallas Cowboys quarterback ultimately decides to end his time with the network after Super Bowl LXI .

An Aikman departure would mean a major change for one of the NFL’s most important broadcasts, especially after a partnership with Joe Buck that has lasted 25 consecutive seasons .

articles.title: A tragedy strikes ESPN star Dan Orlovsky suddenly: "There are no words"
articles.standfirst: The former NFL quarterback has shared devastating news about his family after his brother-in-law, Federico Lascano, died unexpectedly, leaving behind his wife and three sons
articles.summary: The former NFL quarterback has shared devastating news about his family after his brother-in-law, Federico Lascano, died unexpectedly, leaving behind his wife and three sons
articles.body:
D an Orlovsky is facing a heartbreaking family loss after revealing that his brother-in-law, Federico Lascano , died suddenly over the weekend.

The ESPN football analyst shared the news on Thursday, October 15, asking the public to support his sister and her three children as they begin navigating life without their husband and father.

Orlovsky , 43, described the loss as an “unimaginable” tragedy in an emotional message posted on X. Lascano was the longtime partner of Orlovsky’s sister, Christine , and the couple had three sons together: Brayden , 18, Cameron , 16, and Colton , 11.

The sudden death has left the family dealing not only with profound grief but also with the practical challenges that can follow the unexpected loss of a household’s primary partner.

Orlovsky used his social media platform to highlight the difficult position his sister now faces while helping her children come to terms with what happened.

“There are no words to describe the heartbreak of losing a husband, a partner, and a father so suddenly,” he wrote. “In the midst of trying to process this devastating loss, my sister is now facing the overwhelming reality of navigating life as a solo parent and a single-income household, all while helping her boys cope with the loss of their dad.”

The family has not publicly disclosed the cause of Lascano’s death. According to reports from the New York Post and other outlets, he had been part of Christine’s life since their college years, making the loss particularly devastating for those who knew the couple and their family.

Dan Orlovsky asks the public to support his sister and nephews

Alongside his announcement, Orlovsky shared a GoFundMe campaign intended to help the Lascano family manage expenses following the death.

The fundraiser seeks donations to assist with household bills and other costs, while also helping secure educational opportunities for the three boys as they grow older.

Orlovsky stressed that his appeal was about giving his sister and nephews some breathing room during an extraordinarily difficult period. He also encouraged people who could not contribute financially to share the fundraiser so that it could reach a wider audience.

“No family should have to face this kind of heartbreak, and no one should have to worry about how they will manage financially while trying to put the pieces of their lives back together,” he wrote.

He concluded his message by thanking those who had already offered support to the family.

“Thank you for showing up for my sister and my nephews when they need it most. Our family is heartbroken, but we are so grateful for the love and support surrounding them during this unimaginable time.”

The campaign had surpassed $65,000 toward its original $100,000 goal by Thursday morning, according to the information shared alongside Orlovsky’s appeal.

Later reports indicated that donations continued to rise as the news spread, reflecting the response from football fans and people wishing to help the family.

Orlovsky’s ESPN colleague Laura Rutledge was among those who publicly expressed sympathy, writing: “Praying for your family. I’m so sorry,” according to The Spun.

Dan Orlovsky’s career in football and broadcasting

Although he is now widely recognized as a television analyst, Orlovsky first made his name as a quarterback. A native of Shelton, Connecticut, he played college football at the University of Connecticut before the Detroit Lions selected him in the fifth round of the 2005 NFL Draft.

He went on to play for several NFL franchises, including the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts and Tampa Bay Buccaneers , during a professional career spanning 12 seasons.

After retiring in 2017, he joined ESPN in 2018 and gradually became a familiar face across the network’s football coverage.

Orlovsky regularly appears on NFL Live, Get Up and First Take, offering analysis of quarterback play, offensive schemes and the biggest stories in the league. ESPN announced a new multi-year agreement with him in July 2025, reaffirming his place among the network’s leading football voices.

For now, however, the focus is far removed from the NFL season. Orlovsky’s public message has centered on helping his sister and nephews through a loss that has changed their lives without warning.

As the family begins the difficult process of grieving, the fundraiser offers supporters a practical way to help ease some of the financial pressure while they adjust to an uncertain future.

articles.title: Cowboys vs. Packers: kickoff time, where to watch and how both teams are shaping up
articles.standfirst: Dallas looks to turn its season around in a trip to Green Bay, where the Cowboys will try to snap a losing streak against the Packers that has lasted for years.
articles.summary: Dallas looks to turn its season around in a trip to Green Bay, where the Cowboys will try to snap a losing streak against the Packers that has lasted for years.
articles.body:
The Dallas Cowboys face the Green Bay Packers this Sunday, October 18, in a Week 6 NFL matchup that will put two teams with different recent results to the test.

Where to watch Cowboys vs. Packers in the United States

Fans can watch the game on NBC as part of Sunday Night Football . Those who prefer Spanish-language coverage can tune in to Telemundo .

Kickoff is scheduled for 8:20 p.m. ET .

How the Green Bay Packers are looking

Green Bay enters the matchup with a 3-2 record and two consecutive wins . Their most recent performance was convincing, as they defeated the Chicago Bears 31-7 , giving the team a confidence boost heading into its next game.

Quarterback Jordan Love has been a key part of the Packers' offense, leading their passing attack. Green Bay will look to maintain the production it has shown in recent games and take advantage of playing at Lambeau Field in front of its home crowd.

What the Dallas Cowboys need to turn their season around

Dallas comes in with a 2-3 record after falling 24-16 to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers . The result once again highlighted one of the team's ongoing struggles: gaining yards has not always translated into enough points to finish games with a win.

With Dak Prescott leading the offense, the Cowboys have been able to move the ball, but they need to make better use of their opportunities in the red zone and execute consistently in crucial moments. Against Green Bay, turning those possessions into points could make a significant difference.

Another factor adding tension to the matchup is the history between the two franchises. Dallas has not beaten Green Bay since October 2016, making Sunday's game another opportunity to end that drought . Breaking the streak on the Packers' home turf will not be easy, but a victory would also give the Cowboys a much-needed boost in a season in which they need to make up ground.

articles.title: The problem with NFL Sunday Ticket that has fans up in arms: Mike Florio's exposé
articles.standfirst: Subscribers are questioning why local broadcast restrictions can prevent them from watching the opening minutes of major NFL games
articles.summary: Subscribers are questioning why local broadcast restrictions can prevent them from watching the opening minutes of major NFL games
articles.body:
The NFL' s most expensive viewing package is facing renewed scrutiny over a problem that has little to do with streaming quality and everything to do with which games subscribers are permitted to watch.

Mike Florio , founder of Pro Football Talk, has criticized the league after discovering that Sunday Ticket viewers can miss the beginning of late-afternoon games when their local television station remains occupied with an earlier contest.

The issue became particularly apparent during the recent meeting between the San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks , when extended coverage of the Washington Commanders against the New York Giants disrupted the scheduled broadcast.

Although Sunday Ticket is designed to provide access to out-of-market games, its restrictions can leave subscribers unable to watch portions of a matchup that is technically assigned to their local network.

Florio questions NFL over missing game coverage

Florio raised the issue during his Monday show, explaining that the problem extends beyond watching games live because it can also affect recordings.

"This whole 'bonus coverage' thing keeps people from seeing all of the key game in the late afternoon window," Florio said.

The broadcaster explained that he subscribes to Sunday Ticket partly because it allows him to revisit games throughout the week using YouTube TV's recording features.

"So, alright, 49ers-Seahawks let's go. 'Wait, where's the rest of it? It's 4:47 left in the first quarter. Where's the game?'" he recalled.

The situation arises when an earlier broadcast continues beyond its scheduled window, with the network providing additional coverage while another game is already underway.

Because the later matchup remains classified as a local broadcast, Sunday Ticket can restrict access even though viewers aren't receiving that game on their local channel.

NFL Sunday Ticket's $400 price fuels frustration

The problem has become particularly contentious because Sunday Ticket requires a substantial financial commitment from subscribers who want access to games outside their television markets.

The package moved from DirecTV to YouTube in 2023, but the transition hasn't eliminated the restrictions associated with local broadcasting rights.

"This is 2026 the last I checked. We've got artificial, we've got super intelligence," Florio said, questioning why technology has not provided a solution.

"There has to be a way to lift the blackout, so that people who have paid their $400 because they have no choice but to pay for the whole season, to watch all of the games that aren't on in their market."

Florio also raised the possibility of additional legal scrutiny, noting that Sunday Ticket has already faced antitrust challenges over its commercial arrangements.

Angry NFL fans demand answers and refunds

The criticism has resonated with supporters who believe the league should provide uninterrupted access whenever local television coverage prevents them from watching a scheduled game.

"Fans should be demanding partial refunds," one viewer wrote on X. Another supporter described missing the beginning of a featured late-afternoon matchup because an earlier game continued into overtime as particularly frustrating.

Florio argued that the missing minutes could contain decisive moments, making the restriction difficult to justify when subscribers have already paid for premium access.

"Why can't I watch the first 10 minutes of Seahawks-49ers?" he asked.

With no announced solution, the dispute highlights a growing concern among NFL viewers who are paying for additional access which doesn't necessarily guarantee they can watch every moment of the games they want to see.

articles.title: ESPN reportedly identifies Troy Aikman successor as Joe Buck partnership faces split
articles.standfirst: The Hall of Fame quarterback could leave Monday Night Football after this season
articles.summary: The Hall of Fame quarterback could leave Monday Night Football after this season
articles.body:
Troy Aikman is preparing to call ESPN's first Super Bowl in February, but the biggest NFL game on the network's calendar could also mark the end of his five-year stint with Monday Night Football.

The former Dallas Cowboys quarterback is approaching the expiration of his $90 million contract, with no new agreement announced despite longtime broadcasting partner Joe Buck reportedly securing a lucrative extension.

That uncertainty has opened the door to speculation about Aikman's successor, with respected NFL analyst Greg Olsen now emerging as a leading candidate should ESPN decide to make a change.

Sports media insider John Ourand has suggested that Olsen could move from Fox to ESPN in 2027, potentially ending a commentary partnership that has lasted nearly 25 years.

Olsen 's availability could prove significant as ESPN considers its broadcasting plans beyond the current NFL season.

The former Carolina Panthers tight end previously served as Fox's leading analyst before Tom Brady took over the network's premier commentary position.

Olsen subsequently moved into a secondary role alongside Joe Davis , although his performances have continued to earn recognition throughout the industry.

"My best sources are predicting that Greg Olsen will wind up in ESPN's Monday Night Football booth next season," Ourand wrote in his The Varsity newsletter.

Olsen 's existing Fox contract reportedly expires after this season, creating a potential opportunity to pursue another high-profile position.

However, Fox has also discussed retaining the former tight end, while ESPN has made no official announcement concerning Aikman 's future.

Aikman could leave ESPN after season ends

Aikman has done little to dismiss speculation about his next move, recently acknowledging that he expects to become a broadcasting free agent.

Speaking on Dallas radio station 96.7 The Ticket, the three-time Super Bowl champion addressed questions surrounding his future.

"There's probably a time and a place for all that to be discussed. I don't know if now is the time," Aikman said.

"I'll broadcast through this season and I'll be a free agent at the end of the year and kind of see what happens."

His comments followed reports of an argument with Buck ahead of ESPN's October 12 broadcast between the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams .

Front Office Sports reported that the disagreement occurred against the backdrop of contract uncertainty, although neither broadcaster has publicly detailed what happened.

Buck partnership faces uncertain ending

Buck and Aikman first worked together at Fox in 2002 before moving to ESPN in 2022, establishing one of the NFL's most recognizable commentary teams.

Their familiarity has become a defining feature of major NFL broadcasts, with Buck previously explaining why their partnership works so effectively.

"He knows where I'm going to go before I go there. Vice versa," Buck said during an appearance on Front Office Sports Tonight. "He knows I'm his biggest fan."

Buck 's reported six-year extension, potentially worth more than $100 million, contrasts with Aikman 's unresolved contract situation.

Both remain expected to call Super Bowl LXI on February 14, 2027, when ESPN broadcasts the championship game for the first time.

Aikman 's departure is far from confirmed, but the combination of his approaching free agency and Olsen 's potential availability has created genuine uncertainty around the network's future commentary lineup.

His comments followed reports of an argument with Buck ahead of ESPN's October 12 broadcast between the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams .

Buck and Aikman first worked together at Fox in 2002 before moving to ESPN in 2022, establishing one of the NFL's most recognizable commentary teams.

Aikman 's departure is far from confirmed, but the combination of his approaching free agency and Olsen 's potential availability has created genuine uncertainty around the network's future commentary lineup.

articles.title: The NFL and PSG present an exclusive jersey collection inspired by Paris
articles.standfirst: The collection, designed and manufactured by Fanatics in collaboration with Nike, will be available starting October 19 in Paris stores and online.
articles.summary: The collection, designed and manufactured by Fanatics in collaboration with Nike, will be available starting October 19 in Paris stores and online.
articles.body:
The NFL and Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) have unveiled today an exclusive NFL x PSG jersey collection , designed and manufactured by Fanatics in collaboration with Nike, ahead of the celebration of the first NFL regular-season game in France.

The collection features two color combinations, one based on PSG's colors and another in burgundy and gold tones. Both versions are made using the official Nike NFL Stitched Limited jersey as a base and incorporate the PSG crest and details inspired by the French capital.

The first version, Paris Red & Blue, features PSG’s signature blue, combined with a red collar and a white V-shaped insert with the NFL logo. The design incorporates the initials PSG on the chest, white numbers outlined in red, the club crest on both sleeves, and the inscription PARIS beneath a fleur-de-lis on the back of the collar.

For its part, the Monogram edition features a burgundy jersey with gold details, from the NFL shield and the Nike logo to the PSG monogram on the chest. The numbers incorporate a print that combines fleur-de-lis, silhouettes of the Eiffel Tower, and monograms of the Parisian club.

Both jerseys feature the number 75, corresponding to the code of the Paris department. The fleur-de-lis, also present in the PSG crest, is one of the symbols of the New Orleans Saints , who will host the Pittsburgh Steelers next Sunday, October 25, at the Stade de France. On the occasion of the game, the Saints will also release a special edition jersey.

“Our first regular-season game in France marks a milestone for the NFL, and we wanted to offer Paris fans a jersey worthy of the occasion,” said Salha Latif, NFL Vice President of International Consumer Products and Licensing. “Together with PSG, Fanatics, and Nike, we have created something authentically Parisian and unmistakably NFL. French fans have long been waiting to be able to enjoy an NFL game in their own country, and this collection allows them to be part of this moment.”

“Paris has always been a city where sport and fashion meet. We are proud to welcome the NFL and to offer our fans a jersey they will want to wear during the game. In addition, PSG will also play that same Sunday, so it will be a very special day for sport in Paris,” said Richard Heaselgrave, Chief Revenue Officer of Paris Saint-Germain.

“We work daily with the NFL, PSG, and Nike, which has enabled us to develop this jersey paying special attention to every detail. From the fleur-de-lis on the collar to the silhouettes of the Eiffel Tower integrated into the numbers, every element has been conceived with Paris in mind,” explained Stephen Dowling, international president of Fanatics.

The NFL x PSG Nike Stitched Limited jersey, priced at 210 euros, 180 pounds or 225 dollars, will be available from Monday, October 19, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (mainland Spain time), while supplies last.

The jerseys will be available for purchase online through NFL Shop (United States and Europe), PSG Store, and Nike.com, as well as in various physical stores , including the NFL Paris City Centre Store, the NFL Stadium Store at Stade de France, the PSG Store on the Champs-Élysées, the PSG Megastore at Parc des Princes, Nike House of Innovation, and the PSG Store in New York.

articles.title: Randi Mahomes will bring one of the main in-person activities of her Sports Parent Academy to Miami.
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes' mother will host the Ultimate Sports Parent Experience on October 24 at Fontainebleau Miami Beach, where parents and young athletes will be able to participate in panels, activities, and conversations about youth sports.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes' mother will host the Ultimate Sports Parent Experience on October 24 at Fontainebleau Miami Beach, where parents and young athletes will be able to participate in panels, activities, and conversations about youth sports.
articles.body:
Randi Mahomes is bringing her experience as the mother of a professional athlete to a new stage. Patrick Mahomes' mother will host the Ultimate Sports Parent Experience: Miami Edition , a gathering organized alongside Sports Parent Academy and Katalyst Fit that will take place next Saturday, October 24, at Fontainebleau Miami Beach. The event will begin at 2:00 in the afternoon and will run until 6:00 PM.

The proposal is aimed at parents, young athletes, and families who want to learn about other experiences related to sports development and the decisions that accompany a child or adolescent during their training.

Randi personally announced the appointment through her social media and explained that the gathering aims to bring together athletes and families to share stories , conversations, and experiences related to sports.

What will the Ultimate Sports Parent Experience in Miami offer?

Activities will begin at 2:00 PM, with families entering, interactive experiences, a kids' zone, food and drinks, and various offerings from sponsors.

Starting at 3:30 PM, the main stage will open. A conversation with Randi Mahomes, is scheduled there, along with panels featuring local athletes, specialists, and parents of professional athletes. The program also includes a question-and-answer session with the audience.

Among the topics to be addressed are athletic performance, recruiting, NIL, family dynamics, and life after competition. The organization is also planning activities so that parents and children can participate together during the afternoon.

Tickets are priced at $150 for one adult and two children, while each additional minor costs $35.

Randi Mahomes turns her family experience into an academy

The Miami event is part of the expansion of Sports Parent Academy, an initiative that Randi Mahomes launched in 2025 . The project was created as a platform aimed at parents of young athletes and seeks to offer tools to help navigate some of the decisions and challenges that arise during athletic development.

The proposal addresses different stages of an athlete's journey and offers content related to aspects such as training, nutrition, sports psychology, scholarships, and recruiting.

Much of the experience Randi shares comes from her own family. She accompanied Patrick Mahomes throughout his years as an athlete up to his college years at Texas Tech and later his arrival in the NFL, where he became one of the leading figures of the Kansas City Chiefs.

Now she uses that journey to speak with other families going through similar situations, even though their children are still far from professional sports.

Miami will be the project's second stop

The Miami event will not be the first in-person experience organized by Sports Parent Academy. In July, Randi took part in Lubbock, Texas, in the first Ultimate Sports Parent Experience, an event focused on the relationship between parents and young athletes.

At that event, Mahomes shared her experience as the mother of a high-level athlete and spoke about the importance of families supporting their children throughout their athletic development.

Now the project comes to Miami Beach with a four-hour event that will combine conversations, panels, and activities for the whole family.

The event will take place on October 24 at Fontainebleau Miami Beach, just one day before Patrick Mahomes' Kansas City Chiefs visit the Seattle Seahawks. The quarterback's attendance at the event has not been confirmed.
