articles.title: CBS's Jim Nantz suffers embarrassing moment when he gets injured on air while trying to take the ball away from J.J. Watt
articles.standfirst: Watt was giving a demonstration of how the peanut punch technique can be foiled
articles.summary: Watt was giving a demonstration of how the peanut punch technique can be foiled
articles.body:
Jim Nantz discovered how difficult it is to force a fumble in the NFL when the CBS star tried to punch the ball out of J.J. Watt ’s hands during the Buffalo Bills ’ 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders .

The attempt left Nantz grimacing in pain as Watt laughed as the exchange took place during a break in the action before the two-minute warning in the first half at Allegiant Stadium .

Watt , the former All-Pro defensive end working as an analyst for CBS after replacing Tony Romo , demonstrated how defenders use the peanut punch to dislodge the football from an opponent’s grip.

And the 57-year-old Nantz was invited to try the technique against Watt , who stands 6-foot-5 and weighs 288 pounds but despite his best effort, the ball remained firmly in the former athlete’s hands – creating an amusing moment.

“That was so much harder than I thought you were gonna go, but the ball stayed,” Watt said, chucking, to which Nantz replied, “Yeah it did, my wrist is broken.”

The peanut punch became closely associated with former Chicago Bears cornerback Charles Tillman , who developed a reputation for deliberately striking the football during tackles to force turnovers.

And ever since, offensive players have increasingly worked to protect the ball by keeping it secure against their bodies and anticipating attempts to knock it loose as Watt ’s demonstration illustrated the challenge facing defenders.

Even a powerful strike does not guarantee a fumble, as Kenneth Walker displayed for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Miami Dolphins .

There was no confirmation that Nantz had suffered an actual fracture, but he was seen with an ice pack for his hand in the broadcast booth as the second half began on Sunday, October 18.

Bills survive Raiders rally to extend winning run

Meanwhile on the field, Buffalo left its West Coast trip with two victories after following an overtime win over the Los Angeles Rams with a narrow triumph over Las Vegas as the Bills improved to 5-1.

The Raiders slipped to 3-3 after suffering their third consecutive defeat as Josh Allen completed 23 of 33 passes for 255 yards and two touchdowns, tying Jim Kelly ’s franchise record of 258 career touchdown passes.

His spectacular third-quarter throw to Keon Coleman came after he escaped what appeared to be an almost certain sack whilst James Cook also delivered a strong performance after losing fumbles against the Rams earlier in the week.

He rushed 22 times for 95 yards and a touchdown, adding three receptions for 58 yards as Buffalo avoided a turnover for the first time in four games and Cook ’s three-yard touchdown run with 4:43 remaining broke a 23-23 tie, and Tyler Bass added a 38-yard field goal to give the Bills a crucial cushion.

Kirk Cousins threw for 313 yards and two touchdowns for Las Vegas , but the Raiders could not complete their comeback as the Bills ultimately kneeled the game out.

articles.title: "You can't throw like that" Patrick Mahomes admits his mistake after an interception against the Chargers while Travis Kelce was open
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback took responsibility for a risky decision near the end zone during the 22-6 victory over Los Angeles
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback took responsibility for a risky decision near the end zone during the 22-6 victory over Los Angeles
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs earned their fifth consecutive victory by defeat ing the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6, but Patrick Mahomes ended with a play he will surely prefer to forget. The quarterback acknowledged his mistake after throwing an interception in a clear situation to extend his team's lead.

The play drew even more attention when the replays showed Travis Kelce with space near the sideline inside the end zone. Mahomes, however, kept his eyes on Andrew Armstrong while trying to extend the play and ended up putting the ball into the hands of the Chargers' defense.

Mahomes admits his mistake: "I can't throw like that"

The interception came with the Chiefs ahead 9-3, on a third-and-goal from Los Angeles' 2-yard line. Kansas City had regained possession after an interception of Justin Herbert and had a great opportunity to extend its lead even further.

Mahomes rolled out of the pocket to try to extend the play and looked for Andrew Armstrong, but he was hit as he released the ball . The pass fell short and Cam Hart came up with the interception in the end zone.

After the play , Mahomes took responsibility. The quarterback acknowledged that the play became complicated when he left the initial structure and that his final decision was not the right one.

"You can't throw the ball like that," Mahomes admitted after the game.

The play ended up being one of the few blemishes in a performance in which he completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, although he didn't manage any passing touchdowns.

Replays showed Kelce open

Kelce had space near the sideline inside the end zone, but Mahomes didn’t see him and threw the pass to Armstrong.

The tight end was once again an important piece for Kansas City and finished with five receptions for 53 yards.

Mahomes, however, did not need a big aerial output for the Chiefs to dominate the game . The ground attack was once again led by Kenneth Walker III, who rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries.

The mistake didn't change the course of the game

Mahomes' interception had no impact on the scoreboard. The Chargers failed to turn the takeaway into points, and Kansas City remained in control until the end .

The Chiefs went into halftime with a 19-3 lead and ultimately prevailed 22-6. The defense also stepped up again: it held Los Angeles to 259 total yards and allowed only two field goals.

Mahomes could therefore afford a less brilliant night than usual. His only interception stood as a warning sign within a convincing victory that kept Kansas City unbeaten at 5-0.

For the quarterback, the conclusion was simple: the outcome was positive, but next time he will have to read better a play in which, according to the replays, he had a much clearer alternative with Kelce.

articles.title: The awkward reunion between Troy Aikman and Joe Buck in ESPN booth: “It looks tense”
articles.standfirst: The longtime NFL broadcasters returned to Monday Night Football after reports of an argument
articles.summary: The longtime NFL broadcasters returned to Monday Night Football after reports of an argument
articles.body:
The cameras turned toward Joe Buck and Troy Aikman before Monday night's game between the San Francisco 49ers and Washington Commanders , and viewers were watching for something other than the usual pregame analysis.

Just one week after reports emerged of an argument between the veteran broadcasters, their return to ESPN's commentary booth prompted speculation about whether their professional relationship had suffered.

Neither man acknowledged the reported disagreement during the broadcast, and there was no obvious confrontation. Nevertheless, their appearance generated considerable discussion among fans already aware of the uncertainty surrounding Aikman's future.

The underlying issue is significant as Buck has secured his long-term future with ESPN, while Aikman is approaching free agency after five seasons with the network.

The speculation intensified after cameras showed the broadcasters together ahead of kickoff, prompting viewers to offer competing interpretations of their interactions.

"Troy Aikman looks like he hates Joe Buck now," one NFL fan wrote on X. Another commented: "It's so awkward watching Buck and Aikman right now." A third viewer suggested: "It looks TENSE in the booth with Buck and Aikman."

According to Front Office Sports, Buck and Aikman had an argument before the previous week's game between the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams .

The reported disagreement was resolved sufficiently for them to complete that broadcast without any noticeable problems on air.

Aikman's ESPN contract uncertainty

The timing of the alleged confrontation has attracted attention because the broadcasters are approaching very different stages of their ESPN contracts.

Buck , 57, reportedly signed a six-year extension worth approximately $108 million, securing his position with the network well into the next decade.

Aikman , 59, is entering the final months of his five-year, $90 million agreement, which runs through ESPN's Super Bowl broadcast on February 14, 2027.

Speaking on Dallas radio station 96.7 The Ticket, the former Dallas Cowboys quarterback addressed speculation surrounding his future without confirming details of the reported argument.

"There's probably a time and a place for all that. I don't know if now is the time," Aikman said.

"I'll broadcast through this season and I'll be a free agent at the end of the year and kind of see what happens."

His comments left open the possibility of a departure despite his longstanding relationship with Buck .

Does Aikman want to continue alongside Buck?

Although his next contract remains unresolved, Aikman has made clear that separating from Buck isn't necessarily his preferred outcome.

During an appearance on the Sports Media with Richard Deitsch podcast, he admitted expecting negotiations to be completed before the season began.

"I thought something would be done prior to the start of this season," Aikman explained.

"I've never gone into a last year of a contract ever since I signed with the Dallas Cowboys. So I thought that it would be done. It's not."

When asked about the importance of maintaining his partnership with Buck , Aikman offered an unequivocal response.

"Would I like to continue working with Joe Buck moving down the road? 100 percent," Aikman added.

The pair began working together at Fox in 2002 before joining ESPN in 2022, establishing the longest-running NFL commentary partnership in league history.

Their reunion on Monday provided no definitive evidence of an ongoing dispute, but with Aikman's future still undecided, speculation surrounding the broadcasting duo is unlikely to disappear.

Neither man acknowledged the reported disagreement during the broadcast, and there was no obvious confrontation. Nevertheless, their appearance generated considerable discussion among fans already aware of the uncertainty surrounding Aikman's future.
The underlying issue is significant as Buck has secured his long-term future with ESPN, while Aikman is approaching free agency after five seasons with the network.
The speculation intensified after cameras showed the broadcasters together ahead of kickoff, prompting viewers to offer competing interpretations of their interactions.

"Troy Aikman looks like he hates Joe Buck now," one NFL fan wrote on X. Another commented: "It's so awkward watching Buck and Aikman right now." A third viewer suggested: "It looks TENSE in the booth with Buck and Aikman."
According to Front Office Sports, Buck and Aikman had an argument before the previous week's game between the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams .
The reported disagreement was resolved sufficiently for them to complete that broadcast without any noticeable problems on air.
Aikman's ESPN contract uncertainty
The timing of the alleged confrontation has attracted attention because the broadcasters are approaching very different stages of their ESPN contracts.
Buck , 57, reportedly signed a six-year extension worth approximately $108 million, securing his position with the network well into the next decade.
Aikman , 59, is entering the final months of his five-year, $90 million agreement, which runs through ESPN's Super Bowl broadcast on February 14, 2027.

His comments left open the possibility of a departure despite his longstanding relationship with Buck .

articles.title: Is Kylian Mbappé switching sports? The Real Madrid star tries on an NFL helmet and shoulder pads and chooses his new position
articles.standfirst: The French star surprised everyone during a practice when he took off his soccer cleats for a moment and put on the full Atlanta Falcons uniform
articles.summary: The French star surprised everyone during a practice when he took off his soccer cleats for a moment and put on the full Atlanta Falcons uniform
articles.body:
R eal Madrid star and captain of the French national team , Kylian Mbappé , once again became the center of international attention after taking part in a high-profile multidisciplinary event. As part of a communications and outreach initiative promoted by the National Football League (NFL) itself in Europe, the French forward hosted Bijan Robinson , a star running back for the Atlanta Falcons , at the French national team’s training facility in Clairefontaine .

The encounter between these two icons of the global sports world quickly went viral across various digital platforms and social media. Wearing the official Georgia team uniform, the Real Madrid star decided to put on a helmet and full-body pads to experience firsthand the physical demands of high-level competition in the American football league.

During the entertaining joint session, the big question on the minds of those in attendance and fans online was which position the player would fill if he suddenly decided to trade soccer for football. Far from dodging the question, the French forward didn’t hesitate for a second to identify the role that would best suit his well-known skills on the field.

A role tailored to his speed on the grid

“If I played American football, I'd be the guy who runs and catches the ball,” the forward stated bluntly to the event's official microphones and cameras. With this statement, Mbappé confirmed that he would choose to play wide receiver—a key position where acceleration over short distances, top speed, and the ability to get behind opposing defenders are essential for catching the quarterback’s passes.

For his part, Bijan Robinson fully endorsed the French player’s assessment after watching him run some passing routes on the field. The Falcons star praised the Frenchman’s impressive explosiveness and agility, noting that with that speed, he would have the ideal physical profile to outrun cornerbacks and break through defensive lines on any NFL field.

According to reports published by international media outlets such as the sports daily ' Récord ', Mbappé took the drills very seriously and successfully completed several aerial catches. However, the forward did not hide his surprise at how heavy and uncomfortable the helmet and shoulder pads were, admitting that the NFL gear significantly limits the fluid movement he is accustomed to on soccer fields.

Role-playing and private lessons

The team-building session wasn't just a one-way street, as Robinson also laced up his cleats to test his skills with the ball at his feet. As detailed by the newspaper El Comercio, the Real Madrid forward took on the role of personal trainer to teach the American star various exercises in ball control, short passing, and finishing with both feet, emphasizing the use of his weaker foot.

The event also featured top figures from the world of international soccer, including fellow French soccer player Aurélien Tchouaméni , who enthusiastically joined in the activities. Sources from the Al Bat website noted that there was a spirit of camaraderie throughout the filming, including jokes among the athletes and Robinson’s attempts to save shots on goal as the Madrid star took his kicks.

Global strategy to conquer the european market

This media interaction is part of an ambitious marketing and internationalization strategy driven by the NFL’s leadership. The American league seeks to consolidate its presence in Europe by leveraging the appeal of global soccer superstars to connect with younger and more multicultural audiences.

The broadcast of this transatlantic matchup on global platforms coincides with the series of official games that the American league has been regularly scheduling in key European cities such as London , Munich , and Frankfurt . The use of global figures like Kylian Mbappé helps build bridges of affinity between soccer fans and fans of the sport played with an oval ball.

On the NFL’s official social media accounts and Real Madrid’s broadcast channels, fans were quick to react with humor to the hypothetical scenario of seeing the Merengue’s No. 9 play a season of American football. However, to the relief of Real Madrid fans, the Frenchman’s foray was nothing more than a fun publicity stunt and an exchange of skills between two world-class elite athletes.

articles.title: Super Bowl star Cordarrelle Patterson faces serious allegations from wife after domestic violence arrest
articles.standfirst: Patterson was released on $1,000 bond after being charged with domestic assault, according to court records
articles.summary: Patterson was released on $1,000 bond after being charged with domestic assault, according to court records
articles.body:
Former NFL standout Cordarrelle Patterson has been arrested in Tennessee following allegations of domestic assault involving his wife, according to court documents and media reports.

The 35-year-old was taken into custody on Saturday, October 17, and later released after posting a $1,000 bond.

An arrest warrant obtained by TMZ states that Patterson’s wife told police he allegedly grabbed her by the hair and arm during a dispute at their home in Sevierville. She reportedly contacted emergency services after the incident, telling officers she feared for her safety and the safety of their children.

According to the warrant, a responding officer observed bruising on the woman’s left bicep, which authorities described as consistent with her account. The report also states that the alleged assault occurred as she attempted to call 911.

Patterson faces one count of domestic assault. However, the allegations haven’t been proven in court. Reports available at the time of writing didn’t include a public response from Patterson or his representatives.

The case has attracted attention because of Patterson’s lengthy professional football career and his reputation as one of the NFL’s most versatile return specialists.

Patterson’s NFL career and family life

Born in Rock Hill, South Carolina, Patterson attended Northwestern High School before playing college football at the University of Tennessee. His performances earned him a first-round selection in the 2013 NFL Draft, with the Minnesota Vikings choosing him 29th overall.

During his 12-season NFL career, Patterson played for the Vikings, Oakland Raiders, New England Patriots, Chicago Bears, Atlanta Falcons and Pittsburgh Steelers. His ability to contribute as both a running back and kick returner made him a valuable player across multiple franchises.

One of the biggest highlights of his career came in February 2019, when he won Super Bowl LIII with the New England Patriots.

Patterson also earned four Pro Bowl selections and several All-Pro honors. He became particularly well known for his kickoff returns, establishing himself as a dangerous threat whenever he received the ball in open space.

Patterson’s final NFL stint came with Pittsburgh. He signed a two-year contract with the Steelers in April 2024 but was released in July 2025. An ankle injury limited his appearances during the 2024 season.

Away from football, Patterson and his wife, Taylor Quick , reportedly met in 2014 before marrying in July 2024. The couple share three children, including two sons and a daughter.

Further details about the case, including any scheduled court appearances, plea or response from Patterson , weren’t confirmed in the information available at the time of writing.

articles.title: Veteran ESPN host criticizes his own network on air over Troy Aikman's contract dispute
articles.standfirst: Michael Wilbon delivered a passionate on-air message as uncertainty grows over the future of Monday Night Football's broadcast team
articles.summary: Michael Wilbon delivered a passionate on-air message as uncertainty grows over the future of Monday Night Football's broadcast team
articles.body:
A potential shake-up in ESPN 's Monday Night Football broadcast booth is becoming increasingly difficult for the network to ignore, particularly now that some of its most prominent personalities are openly questioning the situation.

Troy Aikman is approaching the final months of his five-year, $90 million contract, with no new agreement announced despite longtime commentary partner Joe Buck reportedly securing a six-year extension worth $108 million.

The uncertainty has prompted speculation that one of the NFL's longest-running broadcasting partnerships could separate after the season, even as the pair prepare to call ESPN's first Super Bowl.

Veteran ESPN broadcaster Michael Wilbon has now entered the debate, using his own television program to make an unmistakable case for retaining Aikman .

During Monday's edition of Pardon the Interruption, Wilbon delivered an unusually forceful endorsement of Aikman while closing the program alongside Tony Kornheiser .

"You know who calls a game better than Troy Aikman, knuckleheads? NOBODY calls a game better than Troy Aikman!" Wilbon declared.

His remarks came amid reports that ESPN has yet to reach a new agreement with the three-time Super Bowl champion, whose current deal expires after Super Bowl LXI.

Wilbon 's intervention was particularly notable because the criticism came from within the network rather than from an outside commentator.

He was also joined in his support by Stephen A. Smith , who praised Aikman and Buck during an appearance on SiriusXM.

"They are the A team. Joe Buck, it don't get no better, play-by-play. Excuse the double negative. It's just the truth," Smith said. "I sincerely hope that we don't lose him as a person that's employed by ESPN."

Aikman acknowledges possibility of leaving

Aikman hasn't publicly announced plans to leave ESPN, but his recent comments suggest he is prepared to consider opportunities elsewhere.

Speaking on Dallas-Fort Worth radio station 96.7 The Ticket, the former Cowboys quarterback addressed his contract situation without committing to another season with the network.

"I'll broadcast through this season and I'll be a free agent at the end of the year and kind of see what happens," Aikman said.

"I'm looking forward to whatever the rest of this season does hold and the Super Bowl and all that and where my next landing spot may be."

His comments followed a Front Office Sports report alleging that Aikman and Buck argued before the recent Buffalo Bills game against the Los Angeles Rams .

Although the reported disagreement has fueled speculation, neither broadcaster has confirmed that their partnership is ending.

ESPN faces difficult decision

Aikman and Buck joined ESPN from Fox in 2022, bringing an established broadcasting partnership that has now lasted 25 seasons.

Their arrival helped strengthen the network's NFL coverage, with Monday Night Football enjoying strong television audiences this season.

Former NFL tight end Greg Olsen has emerged in media speculation as a possible replacement, although ESPN hasn't announced any succession plans.

Former CBS analyst Phil Simms has also suggested the network may already be considering another candidate, without identifying who that might be.

ESPN now faces a significant decision before Aikman 's contract expires following the February 14 Super Bowl.

Whatever the network decides, the prospect of breaking up one of football television's most recognizable partnerships is attracting attention well beyond the negotiating table.

articles.title: Shilo Sanders startles a woman at her door, then gets spooked by Miami rents
articles.standfirst: Shilo is impressed by the woman showing him what could be his next home
articles.summary: Shilo is impressed by the woman showing him what could be his next home
articles.body:
S hilo Sanders’ apartment hunt has had a little bit of everything: an unexpected moment at a woman’s door, a tour that got fans talking about the real estate agent, and rent prices that made him stop and think.

In one of his recent YouTube videos, Sanders and the person helping him find a place arrive at an apartment, but the woman who answers the door does not seem to understand English. Sanders tries a few words in Spanish, including “cash,” but the conversation goes nowhere and they can’t get inside to see the unit.

The awkward exchange wasn’t the only moment viewers noticed. During another tour, Sanders seemed to hit it off with the woman showing him the apartment, prompting fans to joke that he might have been more interested in her than in the place.

The apartment itself had plenty to consider, but the search kept circling back to the same question: how much was he willing to pay to live in South Florida?

Shilo Sanders is building a life beyond football

There is no reliable public estimate of Shilo Sanders’ current net worth. Bankruptcy filings from 2023 listed roughly $11.3 million in liabilities. His reported assets were later revised to about $320,000.

Those are figures from a past filing, not a snapshot of his finances today. Sanders is still seeking to discharge an $11.89 million civil judgment. His bankruptcy trial ended in September, but the judge extended the deadline for final written arguments, pushing a decision to January 2027 or later.

Some viewers might assume Shilo can easily afford a nice apartment, but his finances remain difficult to pin down. As he looks for a place of his own, he is also turning the search into content for his YouTube channel. The channel gives him a way to build his work as a creator while looking for the home he wants, though his earnings from it have not been made public. music.youtube.com

Well Off Media continues to post behind-the-scenes videos about Colorado football, but it is run by Shilo’s older brother, Deion Sanders Jr., and is separate from the university’s own media operation.

His father, Colorado head coach Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders , signed a five-year, $54 million contract extension that runs through the 2029 season. The deal lists a $10 million base salary for 2026.

You might think Shilo can simply pick a place and pay the rent . But with Miami prices this high and his bankruptcy case still unresolved, he’s taking his time. For now, he’s bringing viewers along as he looks for somewhere that feels like home.

articles.title: What NFL Teams have a Bye Week 7? Everyone who's out for this week
articles.standfirst: Four NFL teams will sit out Week 7 of the 2026 season
articles.summary: Four NFL teams will sit out Week 7 of the 2026 season
articles.body:
The NFL season is moving into another crucial stretch, and Week 7 brings a break for four teams as the race for playoff positions continues to develop.

The Buffalo Bills , Jacksonville Jaguars, Los Angeles Chargers and Washington Commanders will not play this week, leaving fans to focus on the 14 matchups scheduled between Thursday, October 22, and Monday, October 26.

Bye weeks are built into the NFL's 18-week regular-season schedule, allowing every team to take one week off while still playing 17 games.

For teams dealing with injuries or inconsistent performances, the break can be particularly valuable. However, it also means supporters will have to wait another week to see their teams back in action.

The four teams taking a break in Week 7 enter it with very different storylines. Buffalo and Jacksonville have made encouraging starts to the campaign, while Washington and Los Angeles have more significant concerns to address before returning to the field.

Which NFL teams are on a bye in Week 7?

The following four teams will be inactive during Week 7 of the 2026 NFL season:

- Jacksonville Jaguars: 4-2

- Los Angeles Chargers: 0-6

- Washington Commanders: 1-4-1

Those records, reported ahead of Week 7, underline the contrast between the teams. The Bills are among the strongest performers so far, and the Jaguars have also put themselves in a promising position.

The Chargers , meanwhile, have struggled to get their season moving, while Washington will have an opportunity to regroup after a difficult opening stretch.

For Buffalo , the timing of the bye could be useful. With a 5-1 record, the Bills have established themselves as contenders, and the extra week provides an opportunity to recover physically and prepare for the challenges ahead. Their supporters will have to wait until Week 8 to see them return to the schedule.

Jacksonville also heads into the break with a winning record. At 4-2, the Jaguars have given themselves a solid platform for the remainder of the season, although the bye does not guarantee that their momentum will continue once they return. They will need to use the time effectively before resuming their campaign.

The situation is rather different for the Chargers . A winless 0-6 start has left Los Angeles with plenty of work to do, and the bye provides a chance for the coaching staff to assess what has gone wrong.

Whether the additional preparation time can help them turn their season around remains to be seen.

Washington, sitting at 1-4-1, also has important questions to answer. The Commanders will have a week to evaluate their performances and look for ways to become more competitive when they return.

What else should fans know about the Week 7 schedule?

While those four teams are away from the action, the rest of the league faces a busy weekend. The schedule includes several matchups that could influence divisional races and the wider playoff picture.

Thursday night's game sees the New England Patriots visit the Chicago Bears . Sunday's slate features the Cincinnati Bengals against the Baltimore Ravens, the Green Bay Packers taking on the Detroit Lions, and the Kansas City Chiefs travelling to face the Seattle Seahawks .

The week concludes on Monday night when the Dallas Cowboys meet the Philadelphia Eagles .

These games provide an opportunity for teams to strengthen their positions while Buffalo, Jacksonville, Los Angeles and Washington watch from the sidelines. With the season still developing, a strong performance in Week 7 could prove important as the competition for postseason places intensifies.

The bye-week calendar will continue in the coming weeks, with the Houston Texans, New Orleans Saints, New York Giants and San Francisco 49ers scheduled to sit out Week 8. Later breaks will be spread across the season, with no teams scheduled for a bye in Week 12 or during Weeks 15 through 18.

For now, the focus is on the four teams taking a breather. Buffalo and Jacksonville will look to preserve their promising starts, while the Chargers and Commanders will hope the pause helps them address their problems. All four will return in Week 8, when the NFL schedule resumes and the push toward the second half of the season continues.

The Buffalo Bills , Jacksonville Jaguars, Los Angeles Chargers and Washington Commanders will not play this week, leaving fans to focus on the 14 matchups scheduled between Thursday, October 22, and Monday, October 26.
Bye weeks are built into the NFL's 18-week regular-season schedule, allowing every team to take one week off while still playing 17 games.

For teams dealing with injuries or inconsistent performances, the break can be particularly valuable. However, it also means supporters will have to wait another week to see their teams back in action.

The four teams taking a break in Week 7 enter it with very different storylines. Buffalo and Jacksonville have made encouraging starts to the campaign, while Washington and Los Angeles have more significant concerns to address before returning to the field.
Which NFL teams are on a bye in Week 7?
The following four teams will be inactive during Week 7 of the 2026 NFL season:
- Jacksonville Jaguars: 4-2
- Los Angeles Chargers: 0-6
- Washington Commanders: 1-4-1

Those records, reported ahead of Week 7, underline the contrast between the teams. The Bills are among the strongest performers so far, and the Jaguars have also put themselves in a promising position.
The Chargers , meanwhile, have struggled to get their season moving, while Washington will have an opportunity to regroup after a difficult opening stretch.

For Buffalo , the timing of the bye could be useful. With a 5-1 record, the Bills have established themselves as contenders, and the extra week provides an opportunity to recover physically and prepare for the challenges ahead. Their supporters will have to wait until Week 8 to see them return to the schedule.

Jacksonville also heads into the break with a winning record. At 4-2, the Jaguars have given themselves a solid platform for the remainder of the season, although the bye does not guarantee that their momentum will continue once they return. They will need to use the time effectively before resuming their campaign.

The situation is rather different for the Chargers . A winless 0-6 start has left Los Angeles with plenty of work to do, and the bye provides a chance for the coaching staff to assess what has gone wrong.
Whether the additional preparation time can help them turn their season around remains to be seen.
Washington, sitting at 1-4-1, also has important questions to answer. The Commanders will have a week to evaluate their performances and look for ways to become more competitive when they return.
What else should fans know about the Week 7 schedule?

While those four teams are away from the action, the rest of the league faces a busy weekend. The schedule includes several matchups that could influence divisional races and the wider playoff picture.

Thursday night's game sees the New England Patriots visit the Chicago Bears . Sunday's slate features the Cincinnati Bengals against the Baltimore Ravens, the Green Bay Packers taking on the Detroit Lions, and the Kansas City Chiefs travelling to face the Seattle Seahawks .
The week concludes on Monday night when the Dallas Cowboys meet the Philadelphia Eagles .

These games provide an opportunity for teams to strengthen their positions while Buffalo, Jacksonville, Los Angeles and Washington watch from the sidelines. With the season still developing, a strong performance in Week 7 could prove important as the competition for postseason places intensifies.

The bye-week calendar will continue in the coming weeks, with the Houston Texans, New Orleans Saints, New York Giants and San Francisco 49ers scheduled to sit out Week 8. Later breaks will be spread across the season, with no teams scheduled for a bye in Week 12 or during Weeks 15 through 18.

For now, the focus is on the four teams taking a breather. Buffalo and Jacksonville will look to preserve their promising starts, while the Chargers and Commanders will hope the pause helps them address their problems. All four will return in Week 8, when the NFL schedule resumes and the push toward the second half of the season continues.

articles.standfirst: The undefeated 49ers and Chiefs put their streak on the line while the Eagles and Cowboys renew their classic rivalry
articles.summary: The undefeated 49ers and Chiefs put their streak on the line while the Eagles and Cowboys renew their classic rivalry
articles.body:
The NFL season's Week 7 arrives with a leading pack that still has not tasted defeat and a handful of franchises already fighting not to sink. Three teams remain with spotless records, and two of them hit the road this week to find out whether their start is real or a mirage.

Meanwhile, the close of the slate saves the main event: the divisional clash between Philadelphia Eagles and Dallas Cowboys at Lincoln Financial Field, a duel steeped in history that this time arrives with both teams in trouble.

The date opens at Soldier Field with the Chicago Bears hosting the New England Patriots (4-2) , two teams arriving with identical records and eager to separate themselves from the middle of the pack.

Sunday features the bulk of the schedule: the San Francisco 49ers, the only completely undefeated team at 6-0, visit an Atlanta Falcons side that needs to stop the bleeding; the Baltimore Ravens travel to Cincinnati to face the Bengals in an AFC North clash where both are fighting for the top of the division.

Venue: Lincoln Financial Field

Where to watch: ESPN and ABC

Featured matchup: Seahawks vs. Chiefs

In sports, Sunday's most enticing game pits the unbeaten Kansas City Chiefs ( 5-0, leaders of the AFC West and with the best defense in the conference, having allowed just 83 points) against the Seattle Seahawks (3-3), who are playing at home and have shown defensive solidity, with a positive point differential of +26.

Kansas City's offense revolves, as always, around quarterback Patrick Mahomes, backed by veteran tight end Travis Kelce and a group of receivers led by Xavier Worthy and Rashee Rice.

In the backfield, Kenneth Walker III provides the running game. The market, however, favors the home team: the Seahawks open as favorites at odds of 1.72 (57% implied) compared with the Chiefs' 2.32 (43%), with a total points line set at 42–42.5.

It is the kind of matchup that is usually decided by details, and the question is whether Seattle's defense can contain the AFC's most efficient offense.

Game of the week: Eagles vs Cowboys

The NFC East classic closes out Monday’s slate at Philadelphia’s Lincoln Financial Field. The context is unusual: both historic rivals come in with 2-4 records, tied in the division behind the New York Giants. For both, it is almost an early final: the loser will be left in a very difficult position in an NFC East that is still wide open.

Despite being level in the standings, the market clearly leans toward the visitors: the Cowboys are favored at 1.53 odds (65.6% implied) compared to 2.86 (34.4%) for the Eagles, who are playing in their home stadium.

The spread is moving between Dallas −3.5 and −4.5, and the total points line is hovering around 43.5–44.5, a sign that an offense-driven game is expected. For Philadelphia, with just 106 points scored in six games (the least productive offense in the NFC along with Kansas City in the AFC), the challenge will be to generate points in front of their home crowd.

Implications in the race for the top spot in each Conference

The top of both conferences is red-hot. In the NFC, the 49ers (6-0) are in control and can extend their lead against Atlanta, while the Vikings (5-0) defend their unbeaten home record against the Colts.

In the AFC, the Chiefs (5-0) lead the West and the Buffalo Bills (5-1) are pressing from the East. The AFC pack is a funnel: the Jaguars, Browns, Patriots, Broncos, Steelers, and Ravens share a 4-2 record, so every Week 7 result reshuffles the wild-card picture. Bengals–Ravens is especially decisive in the AFC North, where the Browns, Steelers, and Ravens are tied at the top.

What is the outlook for NFL Week 7

In the Seahawks vs Chiefs, Kansas City has the roster and the pedigree, but playing in Seattle is never easy; the market points to a narrow home win, and a game that stays under 43 total points seems the most likely scenario.

In Eagles vs Cowboys, market logic favors Dallas by more than a *field goal*, although between divisional rivals so evenly matched in the standings, a nail-biting finish decided in the fourth quarter would not be surprising.

articles.title: NFL cancels fan festival ahead of Steelers vs Saints game in Paris due to violent protests across France
articles.standfirst: Violent demonstrations have forced the cancellation of an official fan event, although the NFL insists the game will proceed
articles.summary: Violent demonstrations have forced the cancellation of an official fan event, although the NFL insists the game will proceed
articles.body:
What was supposed to be a landmark celebration of the NFL 's international expansion has become a complicated security operation, with the league canceling a planned fan gathering ahead of the Pittsburgh Steelers ' meeting with the New Orleans Saints .

The decision affects Steelers House , an event organized in Paris' Bastille neighborhood, where recent unrest has raised concerns about bringing large groups of supporters together.

However, the NFL has made clear that the cancellation doesn't extend to Sunday's game at Stade de France, which remains scheduled as the first regular-season NFL contest played in France.

The announcement comes amid demonstrations over living costs, education and public services that have escalated into violent clashes in several French cities.

The league confirmed Thursday that it had abandoned plans for the Steelers House gathering following discussions about safety in the surrounding area.

"Following recent events in the Bastille neighborhood, and after careful consideration, we felt it appropriate not to move forward with the planned Steelers House fan event in Paris," the NFL said in a statement.

"Preparations for Sunday's NFL Paris game at Stade de France continue as planned, with the NFL working closely with local authorities and partners on all operations and security matters."

Supporters have been advised to consult the NFL OnePass app for information about other activities taking place during the week.

NFL strengthen security arrangements

The decision follows demonstrations that began over concerns about education, rising living costs and declining public services before escalating into clashes across France.

Although many protesters participated peacefully, incidents of violence, looting and property damage have prompted a significant response from law enforcement.

The unrest has created additional challenges for organizers preparing to welcome thousands of international football supporters to the French capital.

NFL executive Peter O'Reilly previously emphasized that protecting everyone involved in the event remained the league's highest priority.

"There's nothing more important from our standpoint than the teams' security, the fans' security -- everybody involved with this game," O'Reilly said during the NFL's fall league meeting.

He explained that league officials were working with French authorities and the United States State Department while reviewing preparations as conditions developed.

Steelers vs Saints remains scheduled at Stade de France

Despite the disruption to off-field activities, the league remains committed to staging its first regular-season game in France on Sunday, October 25.

The Stade de France , located in Saint-Denis, has undergone significant modifications to accommodate the NFL, including improvements to the playing surface, expanded locker rooms and additional broadcasting infrastructure.

The venue previously hosted the 1998 FIFA World Cup final and events during the 2024 Paris Olympics, making it a prominent setting for the league's latest international expansion.

Saints running back Alvin Kamara has expressed enthusiasm about participating in the occasion, which represents another milestone for professional football overseas.

"I'm definitely excited for the scenery and to be a part of it," Kamara said. "It's the first NFL game being played in France."

The league's decision to cancel Steelers House illustrates the challenges surrounding the event, but officials haven't announced any changes to Sunday's kickoff arrangements.

Further security measures will remain an important part of preparations as the NFL attempts to deliver its historic Paris debut despite the unrest.

articles.title: Pat McAfee ‘fails’ with alternative Monday Night Football show
articles.standfirst: The network's latest alternative NFL broadcast has failed to match the audience drawn by Peyton and Eli Manning
articles.summary: The network's latest alternative NFL broadcast has failed to match the audience drawn by Peyton and Eli Manning
articles.body:
P at McAfee has become one of ESPN's most prominent personalities, appearing across the network's biggest programs and developing a devoted following through his outspoken approach to sports commentary.

However, his latest assignment has delivered an unexpectedly modest audience, with the debut of Monday Night Football Field Pass struggling to compete with other NFL broadcasts.

The alternative presentation aired during the San Francisco 49ers ' Week 6 matchup against the Washington Commanders , filling a gap in ESPN's schedule while Peyton Manning and Eli Manning took a break from their regular ManningCast duties.

According to The Athletic's Andrew Marchand, McAfee 's broadcast attracted approximately 351,000 viewers, a figure that fell considerably short of the audience typically watching the Manning brothers.

The reported numbers placed McAfee 's debut behind another alternative NFL presentation, with NFL Network's Next Gen Stats broadcast drawing approximately 469,000 viewers.

Even the ManningCast , which has experienced its own ratings difficulties this season, performed considerably better during its Week 2 presentation of the Giants-Rams game.

That broadcast attracted approximately 661,000 viewers, nearly twice the audience reportedly recorded by McAfee .

"That is around half of what the Mannings have received," Marchand reported when discussing the figures.

He also highlighted ESPN's decision not to confirm the numbers publicly: "ESPN declined to confirm the McAfee numbers, which is not common practice."

The network hasn't suggested that the disappointing debut will affect its existing plans for the alternative broadcast.

Why McAfee faces a difficult challenge

McAfee 's program was designed to provide a different experience from ESPN's traditional Monday Night Football coverage, emphasizing his recognizable personality and informal conversations with colleagues.

However, the network already offers several ways to watch NFL games, including the established commentary partnership of Joe Buck and Troy Aikman .

The Manning brothers have also spent several seasons developing their alternative format, combining football analysis with humor and celebrity guests.

McAfee , meanwhile, remains heavily involved in ESPN's wider programming, hosting his weekday show while contributing to College GameDay and Monday Night Countdown.

His substantial presence across the network demonstrates his popularity, but the debut figures suggest that attracting an established audience to another NFL broadcast may require time.

ESPN confirms more Pat McAfee broadcasts

ESPN has already scheduled several additional Field Pass appearances, giving McAfee further opportunities to establish the format.

His next broadcast is scheduled for Week 9, when the Buffalo Bills visit the Minnesota Vikings .

Additional games include Panthers-Buccaneers in Week 12, Steelers-Jaguars in Week 14 and Giants-Lions in Week 16, with another presentation planned for Week 18.

McAfee is also scheduled to provide alternative coverage of Super Bowl LXI on ESPNU, while the Manning brothers will present their own broadcast on ESPN2.

The upcoming schedule provides ESPN with a broader opportunity to assess whether the format can attract more viewers.

Although McAfee 's debut fell short of expectations suggested by his television profile, a single broadcast cannot determine the long-term prospects of the experiment.

His next appearances will provide a clearer indication of whether Field Pass can establish itself alongside ESPN's existing NFL coverage.

articles.title: Tom Brady’s unusual description of Caleb Williams’ throw drew laughs but the NFL legend knew what he saw
articles.standfirst: A seven-time Super Bowl champion deserved a question, not a laugh
articles.summary: A seven-time Super Bowl champion deserved a question, not a laugh
articles.body:
Tom Brady was breaking down a throw, not trying to coin a catchphrase. During FOX’s broadcast of the Chicago Bears’ game against the Atlanta Falcons , Caleb Williams connected with Luther Burden III for a 25-yard gain. Watching the replay, Brady said, “That ball is gyrating coming out of Caleb’s hands. ” He added that there was “some smoke on the football” when Williams released it.

Kevin Burkhardt laughed and admitted he had never heard that word used to describe a pass. The exchange quickly put Brady’s unusual choice of words at the center of the conversation. But was the word really the point or did the reaction turn a quarterback’s observation into the punchline?

Brady was describing the throw from a quarterback’s perspective

Brady spent 23 seasons reading throws from the pocket and knows how a ball looks as it leaves a quarterback’s hand. “Gyrating” may not be the word every announcer would choose, but Brady tied it to the ball’s movement and the force behind Williams’ release. His phrasing was unexpected; the play he was describing was real.

And Brady wasn’t criticizing Williams. The quarterback completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions as Chicago beat Atlanta 31-23. Brady praised his performance and named him FOX’s LFG Player of the Game. In that context, the comment reads more like an enthusiastic football breakdown than an attempt to sound strange.

Burkhardt’s response showed surprise, but the available clip doesn’t establish that he meant to mock Brady . Still, when a seven-time Super Bowl champion uses a word that sounds unfamiliar, the instinct to laugh can overshadow the insight behind it. Brady’s phrasing may have been unusual; that alone doesn’t make his read of the throw less worth hearing.

Maybe the exchange was simply humorous . Still, broadcasters should listen before turning an expert’s unusual phrasing into a joke. Brady was speaking from experience, and the moment called for a little humility : ask what he saw, consider the play from a quarterback’s perspective and learn from it. A genuine question would have served viewers better than mockery.

articles.title: The NFL runs headlong into the chaos of the Paris protests
articles.standfirst: American football arrives in France for the first time, and it does so amid the protests. The Steelers have chosen to cancel their fan event.
articles.summary: American football arrives in France for the first time, and it does so amid the protests. The Steelers have chosen to cancel their fan event.
articles.body:
This Saturday Paris is preparing for new protests and, judging by how things went last week, security measures are going to be stepped up . This Saturday in the French capital, 70,000 police officers and gendarmes will be deployed to prevent further disorder during the planned social protests. articles.title: Tyreek Hill’s family court fight intensifies as NFL investigation remains open
articles.standfirst: Disputes over parenting arrangements with his estranged wife remain part of the proceedings
articles.summary: Disputes over parenting arrangements with his estranged wife remain part of the proceedings
articles.body:
F ree agent Tyreek Hill faces another legal deadline in his contentious divorce from estranged wife Keeta Vaccaro, who is seeking documentation of his time with their children and his other children.

Vaccaro filed a request for production on October 16 in Miami-Dade County, asking Hill to provide any current parenting plan and records documenting his time-sharing with his 10 children from May 6 through the present. The requested materials include calendars, agendas, travel receipts and flight itineraries. Hill has 30 days from service to respond, placing his deadline in mid-November.

The filing comes days after a civil jury found Hill liable on two battery counts and not liable on eight others, ordering him to pay Vaccaro $500,000. Their divorce began in April 2025, and disputes over parenting arrangements remain part of the proceedings.

Filing follows $500,000 jury verdict

The civil trial featured nanny-camera footage, testimony from Vaccaro and her mother, Alicia Vaccaro , and testimony concerning a therapist’s diagnosis of post-traumatic stress disorder. Financial disputes also figured prominently.

Hill alleged that Vaccaro took approximately $60,000 a month from him without permission, in addition to a $15,000 monthly allowance. He testified that their disagreements began before their November 2023 marriage. Hill also described an incident in Hawaii when he said he discovered that more than $10,000 had allegedly been taken.

“I got furious. I'm like, 'Babe, why are you stealing money? Like, all you got to do is just say, Hey, Reek, like help me out,'” Hill testified. Those financial allegations were part of the broader conflict between the couple, whose separation has involved civil litigation and ongoing family-court proceedings.

Divorce began after police responded to domestic dispute

Hill and Vaccaro’s divorce case began in April 2025, one day after police responded to a domestic dispute in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida . The latest filing adds another issue to the couple’s ongoing legal battle. The requested documents could clarify Hill’s parenting schedule , but the filing itself does not establish that he has violated any parenting obligations.

Hill’s legal challenges also extend to his professional career. The NFL’s review of the receiver under its Personal Conduct Policy remains open, with no final disciplinary decision announced.

The league’s process is separate from the civil trial and divorce proceedings. Hill now faces a mid-November deadline to respond to Vaccaro’s request as the broader legal disputes continue.

articles.title: Kenneth Walker flips defender Baron Browning in a powerful tackle-breaking play
articles.summary: A resurfaced video of running back Kenneth Walker shows just how tough the NFL player is and what a nightmare he has become for defenses all around the league. Former Denver Broncos linebacker Baron Browning tried to tackle the running back, but he wouldn’t go down, so the defender had to suplex Walker. The former Super Bowl MVP returns to Lumen Field this Sunday as the Kansas City Chiefs battle the defending champions Seattle Seahawks, in one of the most anticipated games of the regular season. Walker has shined alongside Patrick Mahomes, and he wants to lift another Vince Lombardi Trophy, this time with Kansas City. So far, Kenneth has provided a much-needed spark to one of the three teams that remains undefeated.
